title: Detecting and Identifying Supernovae in AGN Accretion Disks
background_knowledge: 活动星系核（AGN）由超大质量黑洞吸积物质驱动，其吸积盘在内外尺度上可拥有极高的密度与辐射场。近二十年的研究范式认为，AGN 盘不仅是黑洞吸积的场所，也可能成为恒星形成、捕获与演化的特殊环境：盘内气体可坍缩形成恒星，周围星团或星系核中的恒星也可能被捕获进入盘内。嵌在盘中的恒星演化到末期会发生超新星（SN）爆发，而超新星激波在致密、高温的盘介质中传播时，会经历与常规星际介质中不同的激波动力学、辐射输运和冷却过程。探测这类盘内超新星，可为 AGN 盘中是否存在恒星及其演化提供直接证据，也有助于理解 AGN 盘结构、星-盘相互作用和黑洞吸积演化。观测上的核心挑战是：盘内超新星信号与明亮的 AGN 连续谱叠加，且在致密介质中可能被再处理到红外、光学、紫外乃至软 X 射线；此外，孤立超新星与星周介质（CSM）相互作用也会产生类似激波辐射，因此需要同时讨论可探测性与可甄别性。黑洞质量与 Eddington 比共同决定盘温度、密度和 AGN 本底亮度，是此类理论预测中的关键参数。
contribution: 本文采用解析激波动力学模型与单区辐射模型，系统研究 AGN 吸积盘中超新星（disk SN）的电磁辐射。作者将框架应用于四类前身星，并在一系列 AGN 黑洞质量和 Eddington 比下进行计算，发现**围绕较低质量黑洞或处于较低 Eddington 比的盘内超新星更容易从 AGN 本底中探测出来**，且可在从红外到软 X 射线的更宽电磁波段保持可探测性。然而，**能够从 AGN 本底中探测并不保证能与具有 CSM 相互作用的孤立超新星区分**：与有、无 CSM 相互作用的孤立超新星对比后，作者发现其宏观观测量存在显著简并。尽管如此，他们仍识别出跨前身星类型稳健的独特信号：特征辐射从 \(M_{\rm BH}\lesssim10^7\,M_\odot\) 时的 EUV 转向 \(M_{\rm BH}=10^8\,M_\odot\) 时的 UV/光学，后者的可见时间尺度由不到 1 天增加到 \(\sim3\text{--}70\) 天，峰值温度 \(T_{\rm peak}\sim3\text{--}8\,\mathrm{eV}\)。因此，**在 \(10^8\,M_\odot\) 黑洞周围的 UV/光学波段是探测盘内超新星尤其有前景的方向**。
summary: Stars may become embedded in active galactic nucleus (AGN) accretion disks and eventually explode as supernovae (SNe), whose detection would provide direct evidence for the existence and evolution of stars in AGN disks. We investigate the electromagnetic emission of such disk SNe using an analytic shock dynamics model coupled with a one-zone radiation model. Applying this framework to four progenitor types over a range of AGN black hole masses and Eddington ratios, we find that disk SNe around lower-mass black holes (BHs) or at lower Eddington ratios are more readily detectable against the underlying AGN emission and can remain detectable over a broader range of electromagnetic bands, from the infrared to soft X-rays. However, detectability against the AGN background does not guarantee that disk SNe can be distinguished from isolated SNe with CSM interaction. We therefore further compare disk SNe with isolated SNe with and without CSM interaction and find substantial degeneracies in their macroscopic observables. Nevertheless, we identify distinctive signatures that are robust across progenitor types. The characteristic emission shifts from the EUV for \(M_{\rm BH}\lesssim10^7\,M_\odot\) toward the UV/optical for \(M_{\rm BH}=10^8\,M_\odot\), with the visibility timescale increasing from less than a day to \(\sim3\text{--}70\) days and \(T_{\rm peak}\sim3\text{--}8\) eV in the latter case. The UV/optical regime around \(10^8\,M_\odot\) BHs therefore offers particularly promising prospects for detecting disk SNe.

title: Resolving the Assembly of Disk Galaxies from the Epoch of Reionisation to Cosmic Noon
background_knowledge: 星系形成与演化是天体物理的核心问题之一，旨在理解宇宙中星系如何从原初密度扰动中形成、获得气体、形成恒星并最终演化为今日所见的多样形态。在标准宇宙学模型（$\Lambda$CDM）下，暗物质晕通过等级并合增长，重子物质则通过冷热吸积模式进入晕内，并在角动量守恒与耗散过程的共同作用下逐渐冷却、坍缩形成盘状结构。盘星系的形成与演化涉及多个关键物理过程：气体如何从宇宙网吸积、角动量如何获得与重新分配、重子与暗物质如何协同演化、恒星反馈与活动星系核（AGN）反馈如何调控恒星形成、以及径向气体输运（如棒与旋臂驱动的流入、外流）如何塑造盘的形态与运动学。观测上，冷气体（分子氢与原子氢）是星系组装的直接燃料，其中 CO 与 [C II] 等谱线是追踪分子气体与中性气体的重要探针。高红移（$z>1$）至“宇宙正午”（$z\sim 2$）是盘星系质量与角动量积累的关键时期，但受限于灵敏度和分辨率，当前对冷气体的分辨观测主要局限于大质量、高恒星形成率或引力透镜放大的少数系统，难以代表典型的盘星系前身。因此，该领域正致力于通过下一代亚毫米波/毫米波设施（如 ALMA2040）实现对低质量、主序恒星形成星系的大样本分辨观测，从而建立盘星系组装的统计图像。
contribution: 本文指出，今日盘星系的大部分质量与角动量在 $z>1$ 时已组装完成，但其气体吸积方式、重子与暗物质的共同演化、以及反馈与径向气体输运如何塑造盘结构仍不清楚。解决这些问题需要对冷气体进行分辨观测。ALMA 已在 kpc 尺度分辨 CO 与 [C II] 观测中发现，即使在 $z>2$ 也存在一批出乎意料的旋转主导盘，并展现出与旋臂、棒、潮汐尾一致的动力学特征。然而，这些研究受限于大质量（$M_\star>10^{10.5}$ M$_\odot$）与高恒星形成率（SFRs $\gtrsim 100$ M$_\odot$ yr$^{-1}$）星系，它们只是今日最大质量椭圆星系与盘星系的祖先。**要理解大多数今日螺旋星系（如银河系）如何组装，必须分辨其低质量前身星系，而这些星系在 $z>1$ 时按数量主导了恒星形成星系群体。** 实现该目标需要将谱线灵敏度提高十倍，因此需要下一代亚毫米波/毫米波设施 ALMA2040。**这一灵敏度飞跃将使得对数百个 $M_\star>10^9$ M$_\odot$ 星系（包括位于和低于恒星形成主序带的星系）进行常规分辨研究成为可能，从而提供具有亚 kpc 冷气体动力学与形态约束的代表性统计样本。** 通过独特地在 $z=1-6$ 提供分辨的 CO、[C I] 与 [C II] 观测，**ALMA2040 将追踪比当前可及范围大得多的冷气体库，把分辨研究从稀有的 massive/透镜系统扩展到代表性星系群体，从而彻底改变我们对星系盘形成与演化的认识。**
summary: Most of the mass and angular momentum of today's disk galaxies assembled at $z>1$. Yet, it remains unclear how these galaxies acquired their gas, how their baryons and dark matter coevolved, and how feedback and radial gas transport shaped their disks. Addressing these gaps requires resolved observations of cold gas, which carries most of the mass and angular momentum involved in galaxy assembly. By resolving CO and [C II] at kpc scales, ALMA revealed a surprising population of rotation-dominated disks, even at $z>2$, exhibiting kinematic signatures consistent with spiral arms, bars, and tidal tails. Yet, these studies are limited to massive ($M_\star>10^{10.5}$ M$_\odot$) and highly star-forming (SFRs$\gtrsim 100$ M$_\odot$yr$^{-1}$) galaxies, the progenitors of today's most massive elliptical and disk galaxies. To understand how most present-day spirals (like the Milky Way) assembled, it is crucial to resolve their low-mass progenitors, which dominate the star-forming galaxy population by number at $z>1$. Achieving this goal demands a tenfold increase in line sensitivity and hence a next-generation sub-/millimetre facility: ALMA2040. This leap in sensitivity will enable routine resolved studies of hundreds of $M_\star>10^9$ M$_\odot$ galaxies, including those on and below the main sequence of star-forming galaxies, providing representative, statistical galaxy samples with sub-kpc constraints on the cold gas kinematics and morphology. By uniquely providing resolved CO, [C I], and [C II] observations across $z=1-6$, ALMA2040 will trace a much larger fraction of the cold-gas reservoir than is accessible today, extending resolved studies from rare massive and/or lensed systems to representative galaxy populations. In this way, ALMA2040 will transform our understanding of how galaxy disks formed and evolved.

title: What fuels the growth of stars and black holes in galaxies through cosmic time? The physics and chemistry of the interstellar medium in distant galaxies
background_knowledge: 星系中的重子物质循环——气体冷却、凝聚成分子云、形成恒星，并通过反馈将能量和物质返还星际介质（ISM）——是理解星系形成与演化的核心。冷且含尘埃的星际介质既是新恒星诞生的原料库，也是大质量黑洞吸积增长的重要燃料。在（亚）毫米波段，尘埃连续谱和分子/原子谱线（如 $^{12}$CO 转动跃迁、[C I]、[C II]、HCN、HCO+ 等同位素体）能够穿透尘埃，直接探测这些冷气体的物理条件与化学组成。通过多跃迁、多物种谱线辐射转移建模，可以约束气体密度、温度、动力学、电离/光致解离区结构以及金属丰度等。高红移星系的宇宙学变暗、低金属丰度和低尘埃含量使谱线非常微弱，因此提升干涉仪的瞬时谱线灵敏度和瞬时带宽，是系统研究典型遥远星系冷 ISM 的关键。
contribution: 本文指出，星系中重子物质（气体、尘埃、恒星）的相互作用对理解宇宙时间尺度上的星系形成与演化具有基础性作用；（亚）毫米波段为测量驱动遥远星系恒星形成与大质量黑洞增长的冷尘埃气体库提供了独特窗口。大型亚毫米波干涉仪已革命性地描绘了本地宇宙之外星系的冷气体与尘埃，但谱线灵敏度限制仍是重大瓶颈：经过十余年巡天，由 $^{12}$CO 示踪的分子气体仅在 $z>1$ 的数十个典型大质量主序恒星形成星系中被测量，更暗的气体示踪物种只限于最亮星系，从而无法获得遥远宇宙典型星系冷气体云的详细条件。本文论证，具有瞬时谱线灵敏度大幅提升和宽频谱覆盖的旗舰级亚毫米波干涉仪 **ALMA2040** 将填补这一空白，使对成千上万个跨越不同星系族群和红移的典型星系开展丰富的多跃迁、多物种、多同位素体原子与分子 ISM 研究成为可能。**这将揭示 ISM 如何在星系族群中随宇宙时间演化，实现对典型星系多相 ISM 物理条件与化学的精细研究，并阐明冷 ISM 如何调控并响应恒星形成和黑洞增长，从而推动宇宙时间尺度上星系组装研究取得巨大飞跃。**
summary: The interplay between the baryonic matter in galaxies (gas, dust, stars) has a fundamental role in our understanding of galaxy formation and evolution through cosmic time. The (sub)mm regime provides a unique window to measure the physical conditions and chemistry in the cold and dusty gas reservoirs that fuel the formation of new stars and the growth of massive black holes in distant galaxies. Large sub(mm) interferometers have made a revolutionary impact mapping the cold gas and dust in galaxies beyond the local universe. However, significant progress is hampered by limited spectral-line sensitivity. After more than a decade of surveys, molecular gas (traced by 12CO) has been measured only in a few tens of typical, massive main-sequence star-forming galaxies at z>1, while access to fainter gas-tracing species has been limited to only the very brightest galaxies. Thereby it restricts access to the detailed conditions in the cold gas clouds in typical galaxies in the distant universe. A revolutionary, flagship sub-mm interferometer with a massive increase in instantaneous spectral line sensitivity and broad spectral grasp (ALMA2040) fills this gap by enabling rich, multi-transition, multi-species and multi-isotopologue studies of the atomic and molecular interstellar medium for thousands of typical galaxies across galaxy populations and redshift. This will unveil how the ISM evolves across the galaxy population for statistical samples in different redshift bins, detailed studies of the physical conditions and chemistry in the multi-phase interstellar medium of typical galaxies, and how the cold ISM regulates and responds to star- and black-hole formation, providing a tremendous leap forward in the study of galaxy assembly over cosmic time.

title: The ALMA-QUARKS Survey. IV. Core Mass Function and Evolutionary Trends in Core Formation Efficiency and Chemistry
background_knowledge:
大质量恒星形成通常发生在巨分子云内部的致密团块与嵌入原星团中。它们寿命短、消光强、反馈剧烈，因此观测上很难像低质量恒星形成那样逐一解析。当前研究范式是：先确定团块中致密核（dense core）的数目、质量分布与演化状态，再将其与初始质量函数（IMF）比较，以检验恒星质量是否主要继承自核质量分布。核质量函数（CMF）常表示为 $ \mathrm{d}N/\mathrm{d}\log M \propto M^{-\gamma} $，高质端斜率 $ \gamma $ 是关键参数；若接近 Salpeter 型（$ \gamma \approx 1.35 $），则支持核质量分布与恒星质量分布直接相关。核心形成效率（core formation efficiency, CFE）则衡量母团块气体被转化为致密核的比例，可能随团块演化而上升。
\n化学方面，不同演化阶段的核具有不同谱线特征：无星核、原恒星核、热核及 H II 区候选体可通过 CO 外流、H30α、CH3CN、CH3OH 等诊断区分；氘化分子（如 DCN、DCO$^+$、NH$_2$D 等）对低温、早期化学尤其敏感。ALMA 在毫米/亚毫米波段的干涉观测能以约 $ 10^3 $ au 的物理分辨率解析大质量原星团，使得对大样本致密核进行统计分类、质量函数与化学演化研究成为可能。QUARKS 巡天即针对 ATOMS 样本中的大质量原星团开展此类观测，ASHES 则是可比较的同类巡天。
contribution:
论文基于 ALMA-QUARKS 巡天，对从 ATOMS 巡天选取的 139 个大质量原星团进行 1.3 mm 观测，角分辨率约 $ 0.3^{\prime\prime} $，在样本中位距离约 3.8 kpc 处对应约 $ 10^3 $ au。作者使用 getsf 识别出 3374 个致密核，并依据谱线诊断（如 H30α、CH3CN、CH3OH）与 CO 外流关联，将其分类为无星核、原恒星核、热核或 H II 区候选体，由此构建包含核物理性质的大样本目录，用于统计研究大质量原星团环境中的致密核族群。
\n在排除受距离效应偏置的 H II 区候选体后，得到的全局核质量函数（CMF）在高质端具有相对平坦的幂律斜率：**$ \mathrm{d}N/\mathrm{d}\log M \propto M^{-\gamma} $，其中 $ \gamma = 0.98 \pm 0.03 $**。相比之下，在单个距离分箱内测得的高质端斜率近似 Salpeter 型，但其拟合得到的低质量下限随距离增加而增大。
\n论文进一步考察全样本的核心形成效率（CFE），发现其与母团块的光度-质量比正相关，**与致密核所集中质量比例随演化增加的图景一致**。作者还研究不同分子示踪物的探测率，发现化学特征随演化阶段呈系统性变化。与 ASHES 巡天比较，**即使处于相同演化阶段的核，其氘化物种探测率也存在显著差异，表明环境对核的化学演化具有重要影响**。
summary: The ALMA-QUARKS (Querying Underlying Mechanisms of Massive Star Formation with ALMA-Resolved Gas Kinematics and Structures) survey targets 139 massive protoclusters selected from the ATOMS survey. The targets were observed at 1.3~mm wavelength with an angular resolution of $\sim0.3^{\prime\prime}$, corresponding to $\sim10^3$~au at the sample's median distance of $\sim3.8$~kpc. Using \texttt{getsf}, we identify 3374 dense cores and classify them as starless, protostellar, hot core, or H{\sc ii} region candidates based on spectral-line diagnostics (e.g., H30$α$, CH$_3$CN, and CH$_3$OH) and CO outflow associations. The resulting catalog provides core physical properties and enables statistical investigations of dense core populations in massive protocluster environments. The derived global core mass function (CMF) after excluding H{\sc ii} region candidates, which is biased by distance effects, has a relatively flat power-law slope at the high-mass end ($\mathrm{d}N/\mathrm{d}\log M \propto M^{-γ}$, with $γ=0.98\pm0.03$). In contrast, the measured high-mass slopes in individual distance bins are approximately Salpeter-like, while their fitted lower mass limits increase with distance. We further examine the core formation efficiency (CFE) across the full sample and find that it positively correlates with the luminosity-to-mass ratio of the parental clumps, consistent with an evolutionary increase in the fraction of mass concentrated into dense cores. We also investigate the detection rates of different molecular tracers and find systematic chemical variations with evolutionary stage. Compared with the ASHES survey, we find that the detection rates of deuterated species vary significantly even for cores at the same evolutionary stages, suggesting an important environmental influence on the chemical evolution of cores.

title: The unified Bound Dark Energy--Bound Dark Matter model: theory and constraints from DESI DR2
background_knowledge: 现代宇宙学标准模型（ΛCDM）认为宇宙由普通重子物质、冷暗物质和暗能量构成，其中暗能量驱动当前宇宙加速膨胀，暗物质则提供星系旋转曲线、星系团质量、宇宙微波背景和大尺度结构所需的额外引力。暗能量的宏观行为常用状态方程 $ w = p/\rho $ 描述：宇宙学常数对应 $ w = -1 $，而动力学暗能量可能随红移演化，并可能穿越 phantom divide $ w = -1 $。近年来 DESI BAO 等数据对演化暗能量给出提示，常用 $ w_0w_a $ CDM 等参数化检验；同时，暗物质与暗能量的物理本质仍未知，粒子物理中的暗部门（dark sector）模型尝试从规范相互作用、禁闭或凝聚机制统一或分别产生二者。约束这类模型通常联合 CMB、BAO、超新星等观测，并用 $ \chi^2 $、DIC、贝叶斯因子等比较模型拟合优度与复杂度。
contribution: 论文提出统一的 Bound Dark Energy--Bound Dark Matter（BDE-BDM）模型，用一个超对称 $ SU(3) $ 规范群及 $ N_f = 6 $ 个味同时导出暗能量和全部暗物质。**规范耦合统一在不使用任何宇宙学数据之前就预言凝聚尺度 $ \Lambda_c = 34^{+16}_{-11}~\mathrm{eV} $**，因此暗能量部分不增加 ΛCDM 之外的新参数，暗物质部分仅增加一个参数。作者联合拟合 DESI DR2 BAO、Planck CMB、Planck+ACT DR6 CMB lensing，以及 PantheonPlus、Union3.1、DES-Dovekie 三个超新星汇编；对 Union3.1 得到 $ \Lambda_c = 43.67 \pm 0.13~\mathrm{eV} $，落入理论预言范围，**实现了高能理论预言与晚期宇宙测量的吻合**。模型的状态方程演化到 $ w_0 = -0.9262 \pm 0.0005 $，且**不穿越 phantom divide**。相对于 ΛCDM，它把 DESI BAO 的 $ \chi^2 $ 降低 $ 2.95 $ 至 $ 3.67 $，把超新星 $ \chi^2 $ 降低 $ 2.53 $ 至 $ 4.07 $，并恢复 $ w_0w_a $ 用两个暗能量参数对同一数据所获总降低量的 57% 至 71%；在三个超新星汇编中的两个上，其 BAO $ \chi^2 $ 达到两模型中的较低值。相对于 ΛCDM 的 $ \Delta \mathrm{DIC} $ 对所有汇编都为强证据，介于 $ -8.28 $ 到 $ -7.47 $，变化仅 $ 0.81 $，而 $ w_0w_a $ 的变化为 $ 4.8 $。由于暗能量部分未增加 ΛCDM 之外的参数，似然增益能经受 Occam 惩罚：相对 ΛCDM 的 $ \ln B $ 为 $ +4.09 $、$ +4.12 $、$ +4.83 $，而 $ w_0w_a $ 给出 $ -2.11 $、$ -0.26 $、$ -0.56 $。在六个将宇宙学常数、$ w_0w_a $ 参数化或 bound dark energy 与 cold 或 bound dark matter 配对的模型中，BDE-BDM 具有最大的贝叶斯证据。
summary: The unified Bound Dark Energy--Bound Dark Matter (BDE-BDM) model derives both the dark energy and the whole of the dark matter from a single supersymmetric $SU(3)$ gauge group with $N_f=6$ flavors. Gauge-coupling unification predicts the scale at which it condenses, $\Lc=34^{+16}_{-11}$~eV, before any cosmological data are used, so the dark-energy sector adds no parameter to those of \LCDM\ and the dark-matter sector adds only one. Fitting DESI DR2 BAO, Planck CMB, Planck+ACT DR6 CMB lensing, and three supernova compilations (PantheonPlus, Union3.1, DES-Dovekie) gives, for Union3.1, $\Lc=43.67\pm0.13$~eV, inside the predicted range: a high-energy prediction met by a late-time measurement. The equation of state evolves to $w_0=-0.9262\pm0.0005$ and never crosses the phantom divide. Relative to \LCDM\ the model lowers the DESI BAO $χ^2$ by $2.95$--$3.67$ and the supernova $χ^2$ by $2.53$--$4.07$, recovering $57\%$--$71\%$ of the total reduction that \wowa\ obtains by fitting two dark-energy parameters to the same data, and reaching the lower BAO $χ^2$ of the two models for two of the three compilations. Its $Δ\mathrm{DIC}$ against \LCDM\ is strong for every compilation, $-8.28$ to $-7.47$, varying by $0.81$ where that of \wowa\ varies by $4.8$. Because the dark-energy sector adds no parameter to those of \LCDM, the likelihood gain survives the Occam penalty: $\ln B=+4.09$, $+4.12$, and $+4.83$ against \LCDM, where \wowa\ gives $-2.11$, $-0.26$, and $-0.56$. Among six models pairing a cosmological constant, the \wowa\ parametrization or bound dark energy with cold or bound dark matter, BDE-BDM has the largest Bayesian evidence.

title: The Impact of High-Mass Clusters on the Binary Black Hole Merger Rate over Cosmic Time
background_knowledge: 引力波天文学通过 LIGO/Virgo/KAGRA（LVK）等探测器观测双黑洞并合，已成为研究致密天体形成与演化的重要窗口。双黑洞并合的主要形成通道可粗分为两类：孤立双星演化，以及致密星团中的动力学形成。在球状星团和核星团等高密度环境中，黑洞会通过动力学交会、双星交换、三体相互作用和引力波辐射逐步硬化并并合；若并合反冲速度小于星团逃逸速度，并合产物可留在星团内并再次参与并合，形成层级并合（第二代及更高代），从而产生更大质量的黑洞。星团的初始质量函数在高质量端通常呈指数截断，因此极高质量星团虽稀少，却可能是层级并合的主要场所。金属丰度控制恒星风质量损失和黑洞质量，维里半径等结构参数影响逃逸速度与并合产物保留。要从宇宙学尺度预言并合率，需要把星团形成率、星团质量、金属丰度与结构分布以及从星团形成到并合的延迟时间分布卷积起来；CMC 等蒙特卡洛模型可模拟大 $N$ 星团的恒星演化与动力学，给出并合权重和延迟时间。由此得到的并合率与性质，可与 LVK 观测分布比较，并约束星团形成模型、层级并合比例以及星团初始质量函数高质量端，例如 Schechter 质量 $M_S$。
contribution: 本文基于覆盖星团质量、金属丰度和维里半径观测参数空间的 CMC 模型网格，给出致密星团产生双黑洞并合率的宇宙学计算。作者首次把 $N=10^{7}$ 粒子的 CMC 模型纳入计算，并加入新的太阳金属丰度模型，将 CMC Cluster Catalog 扩展到本地宇宙观测到的最重星团；随后用解析星团形成模型将星团形成率与模型给出的延迟时间分布卷积。结果表明，本地宇宙星团 BBH 并合率主要由低质量并合主导，典型主并合黑洞质量满足 $M_1 \lesssim 20\,M_\odot$，且这些并合来自近期形成的高金属丰度星团。**高质量星团虽然是层级并合（第二代及更高代）的主要场所，但其对总并合率的贡献被星团初始质量函数的指数截断强烈压低。**因此，层级并合率对 Schechter 质量 $M_S$ 的取值高度敏感，**引力波对层级并合比例的约束可独立限制星团初始质量函数的高质量端**。该形成模型无需精细调节即可重现观测到的今日球状星团数密度；与 Virgo 球状星团质量分布的最佳匹配为 $M_S = 10^7\,M_\odot$。在此取值下，**本地动力学并合中有 27% 为层级并合**，而经典取值 $M_S = 10^{6.26}\,M_\odot$ 对应 18%。作者公开了并合权重，可用于与 LVK 分布及其他形成模型直接比较。
summary: We present a cosmological calculation of the binary black hole merger rate from dense star clusters, using a $\texttt{Cluster Monte Carlo}$ ($\texttt{CMC}$) model grid spanning the full observed parameter space of cluster mass, metallicity, and virial radius. For the first time, we incorporate $N=10^{7}$-particle $\texttt{CMC}$ models into this calculation, including a new solar-metallicity model, extending the $\texttt{CMC Cluster Catalog}$ to the most massive clusters observed in the local Universe. Using an analytic cluster formation model which convolves the cluster formation rate with delay-time distributions from our model suite, we find that the local cluster BBH merger rate is dominated by low-mass ($M_1 \lesssim 20\,M_\odot$) mergers originating from recently formed, high-metallicity clusters. While high-mass clusters are the primary sites of hierarchical (second-generation and higher) mergers, their contribution to the overall merger rate is suppressed by the exponential cutoff of the cluster initial mass function. The hierarchical merger rate is therefore highly sensitive to the exact value of the Schechter mass, $M_S$, suggesting that gravitational wave constraints on the hierarchical merger fraction can independently constrain the high-mass end of the cluster initial mass function. Our cluster formation model reproduces the observed present-day GC number density without fine tuning, and we find $M_S = 10^7\,M_\odot$ provides the best match to the observed Virgo GC mass distribution. For this value, $27\%$ of local dynamical mergers are hierarchical, compared to $18\%$ for the canonical value of $M_S = 10^{6.26}\,M_\odot$. Our merger weights, which we make publicly available, can be used for direct comparison with LVK distributions and other formation models.

title: CHARIZARD: A High-throughput Generic Pipeline for Present and Upcoming Interferometers
background_knowledge: 射电干涉阵列由多台天线组成，通过互相关测量同一波前的可见度函数（visibility），在 $u$-$v$ 平面采样后经傅里叶变换重建天空亮度分布。现代阵列如 MeerKAT、ASKAP、LOFAR 及未来的 SKA 具备宽带宽、高灵敏度和大量频率通道，单次观测的原始 measurement set 常达 TB 量级。标准处理流程包括射频干扰（RFI）flagging、基于校准源的 cross-calibration、利用成像模型迭代改进的 self-calibration、去卷积成像，以及全 Stokes 偏振成像。对于偏振，Stokes $I$、$Q$、$U$、$V$ 需通过不同馈源相关组合测量，并校准仪器偏振泄漏与方位角效应。随着数据量、通道数和偏振自由度增加，瓶颈往往不只在算法本身，还在于如何把 flagging、校准、成像等任务高效映射到集群的计算、内存与 I/O 资源上。PBS 与 SLURM 等作业调度器、容器化环境和可复现工作流因此成为射电天文软件基础设施的核心。该方向的目标是让用户在无管理员权限、不同集群环境下，也能自动化、可扩展地处理大规模干涉观测。
contribution: 论文提出 CHARIZARD，一个面向当前与下一代射电干涉阵列的高吞吐通用管线，将原始 measurement set 依次经过 flagging、cross-calibration、self-calibration 与成像，输出 full-Stokes 图像。其核心设计是分布化工作流：观测频带被重划分为若干子带，子带在 cross-calibration 阶段保持独立；self-calibration 阶段以目标场与子带对为工作单元；处理互不重叠数据的阶段可并行运行。每个阶段都是普通 PBS 或 SLURM 作业，由调度器无关层提交与追踪；所有计算在单一 rootless 容器内运行，使无管理员权限的用户在不同集群上获得一致行为。作者用 MeerKAT 全偏振校准测量进行基准测试：轴上仪器偏振残差为 **线性 $0.13\%$ 、圆偏振 $0.06\%$** ；最深场在 $787$ MHz 带宽下达到 **$4.11\,\mu\mathrm{Jy}\,\mathrm{beam}^{-1}$** ，且 $\sigma_I/\sigma_V = 1.010$ ；位置与 RACS-low 符合优于 $0.4\arcsec$ ，流量密度中位比值为 **$1.06$** 。一个 $1.5$ TB 的跟踪观测在包含 self-calibration 与偏振校准的情况下，用 $18.4$ 小时完成 $48.6$ core-hours 的计算。面对下一代射电望远镜的海量数据，CHARIZARD 展示了通过工作分布来应对庞大处理需求的一种可行路径。
summary: Radio interferometers now deliver wide bandwidths and high sensitivity, and with them data volumes that are awkward to reduce by hand and slow to reduce automatically. The limit is not always the algorithms themselves but the way the work is laid out across the computing available. We present CHARIZARD, a pipeline that carries a raw measurement set through flagging, cross-calibration, self-calibration and imaging to full-Stokes images, and which is built around distributing that work. The observing band is repartitioned into sub-bands that stay independent through cross-calibration, the unit of work becomes the target field and sub-band pair at self-calibration, and stages touching disjoint data are run together. Each stage is an ordinary PBS or SLURM job, submitted and tracked by a scheduler-agnostic layer, and every computation runs inside a single rootless container, so a user holding no administrative rights gets the same behaviour on any cluster. We benchmark the pipeline on MeerKAT measurements with full polarization calibration. Residual on-axis instrumental polarization is $0.13$ per cent in linear and $0.06$ per cent in circular; the deepest field reaches $4.11\,μ$Jy~beam$^{-1}$ over $787$~MHz with $σ_I/σ_V = 1.010$; positions agree with RACS-low to better than $0.4\arcsec$ and flux densities to a median ratio of $1.06$. A $1.5$~TB track completes $48.6$ core-hours of work in $18.4$~hours with self-calibration and polarization calibration. The next generation of the radio telescopes will not be short of data. CHARIZARD attempts to show how the distribution of the work provides a useful alternative for handling the staggering processing requirements.

title: Frontiers of chemical complexity in the interstellar medium: unveiling the cosmic origins of life
background_knowledge: 星际介质（ISM）是恒星与行星形成的原料库，其中弥漫的气体与尘埃在致密分子云、原恒星包层、原行星盘等环境中经历复杂的气相化学与尘埃表面化学。射电和亚毫米波天文学通过分子的转动能级跃迁来识别物种：不同分子具有指纹式的跃迁频率，谱线强度与频率信息可用来反推柱密度、激发温度和分子丰度。过去数十年，观测已把星际化学从简单双原子分子推进到复杂有机分子（COMs），并将星际分子与彗星、陨石以及地球前生命化学联系起来。该领域的核心问题包括：星际化学复杂度最高能达到什么程度？从分子云到行星系统的演化过程中，哪些分子能够保存或新生？这些分子是否构成生命所需的前生命分子原料库？由于复杂分子的谱线通常较弱、频率覆盖宽，并且可能分布在延展空间尺度上，宽频段、高灵敏度、高空间保真度的观测是推动该领域发展的关键。
contribution: 本文围绕星际介质化学复杂度这一前沿，指出目前已确认超过 350 个星际分子，其中包括日益复杂的有机分子以及含第二周期以外元素的物种，但星际化学复杂度所能达到的极限、其从分子云到行星系统的演化，以及其对生命分子原料库的贡献仍缺乏约束。作者强调，要在恒星与行星形成环境中探测氨基酸、核碱基、糖类和脂类等物种的多条弱转动跃迁，需要灵敏的宽带观测。现有设施（包括 ALMA）受限于瞬时频谱覆盖、灵敏度（尤其在延展空间尺度上）以及总带宽与积分时间之间的权衡。为此，**ALMA2040 拟通过至少十倍的光谱线灵敏度提升、从亚角秒到数十角秒尺度的高保真成像、以及 35 至 950 GHz 的高光谱分辨率超宽瞬时频率覆盖来突破这些限制**。这些能力将支持对相对 $H_2$ 丰度低于 $10^{-11}$ 的物种进行系统性探测，通过多条跃迁识别新的复杂分子与含重元素物种，并获得跨演化阶段的完整分子清单。**ALMA2040 因而有望全面研究化学复杂度的出现与演化，并判定前生命化学的分子前体是否在银河系中广泛存在**。
summary: The interstellar medium (ISM) contains a rich molecular inventory that provides a unique window into the chemistry operating during star and planet formation and its connection to prebiotic chemistry. More than 350 interstellar molecules are currently known, including increasingly complex organic molecules and species containing elements beyond the second row of the periodic table. Yet the limits that interstellar chemical complexity can reach, its evolution from molecular clouds to planetary systems, and its contribution to the molecular feedstock of life remain poorly constrained. Addressing these questions requires sensitive, broadband observations capable of detecting multiple weak rotational transitions of molecular species, such as amino acids, nucleobases, sugars and lipids, towards star- and planet-forming environments. Current facilities, including ALMA, are limited by instantaneous spectral coverage, sensitivity (especially on extended spatial scales), and the trade-off between total bandwidth and integration time. The proposed ALMA2040 facility would overcome these limitations through at least a tenfold improvement in spectral-line sensitivity, high-fidelity imaging from sub-arcsecond to tens-of-arcsecond scales, and ultra-broad instantaneous frequency coverage from 35 to 950 GHz at high spectral resolution. These capabilities would allow systematic detections of species with molecular abundances with respect to H$_2$ below 10$^{-11}$, facilitating the identification of new complex and heavy-element-bearing species through multiple transitions, and providing complete molecular inventories across evolutionary stages. ALMA2040 would thus make it possible to comprehensively investigate the emergence and evolution of chemical complexity, and to determine whether molecular precursors of prebiotic chemistry are widespread throughout the Galaxy.

title: WALTzER: Wide-band Atmospheric Laboratory for Transiting Exoplanet Research
background_knowledge: 系外行星大气研究是当代天体物理的核心前沿之一，其主旨是回答行星大气如何起源、如何演化，以及低层与高层大气之间如何耦合。最主要的观测手段是凌星法：当行星从母星前方经过时，极小一部分星光会穿过行星大气的临边并发生吸收，由此形成依赖于波长的透射光谱；当行星转到母星背后时，则可测量其热辐射与反射光。透射信号的振幅大致正比于大气标高与恒星半径之比的平方，对热木星一类富气体巨行星约为 $10^{-4}$ 至 $10^{-3}$ 量级，因此必须依赖高精度、长期稳定且波段尽量宽广的观测。不同波段探测的物理过程互不相同：近紫外（NUV）与可见光波段对瑞利散射、碱金属共振线以及正在逃逸的扩展大气敏感，是研究大气逃逸与外层大气结构的关键窗口；近红外（NIR）则包含水、甲烷、一氧化碳、二氧化碳等分子的振动—转动吸收带，反映较低层大气的化学成分与温度结构。目前哈勃空间望远镜（HST）覆盖紫外到近红外但已接近寿命末期，詹姆斯 · 韦布空间望远镜（JWST）在红外波段的精度极高却缺乏紫外与可见光能力，地面高分辨率光谱仪则受地球大气与昼夜循环的限制。与此同时，恒星黑子、耀斑与米粒组织等自身活动会在透射光谱中引入与行星信号同量级甚至更强的系统误差，而恒星活动本身跨越紫外到红外全部波段。因此，能够对同一目标同时开展紫外、可见与红外观测，并把行星信号与恒星变源一并表征的专用空间平台，成为该领域迫切的需求。
contribution: WALTzER（Wide-band Atmospheric Laboratory for Transiting Exoplanet Research）是欧洲空间局（ESA）F3 任务的候选方案，旨在通过同时进行的低分辨率光谱与高精度测光观测来回应上述需求。论文梳理了该任务的主要科学驱动，并给出了任务概念与仪器设计。在波段覆盖上，WALTzER 同时获取近紫外（NUV：240--325 nm）与可见光（VIS：450--820 nm）两个波段的中等分辨率光谱，以及近红外（NIR：900--1700 nm）的宽波段测光，从而把低层大气与高层大气的信息纳入同一套观测中，并同步刻画行星与大气的时变以及恒星的自身变源。载荷由一台口径 35 cm 的卡塞格林望远镜构成，其光路馈入三个共对准通道（即 NUV、VIS、NIR），三者共用同一套光学链路，以最小化仪器系统误差并最大化观测效率。**凭借这种宽波段、同时性的观测能力，WALTzER 有望实现对 30 余颗富气体系外行星大气的探测与表征**，并为太阳系天体与银河系天体物理的多种科学目标提供数据支持。
summary: Understanding the origin and evolution of planetary atmospheres, and the connection between their lower and upper atmospheric layers, remains a fundamental challenge in exoplanet science. Addressing these questions requires observations spanning a broad wavelength range, from the ultraviolet to the near-infrared, together with the ability to simultaneously characterise planetary and stellar variability. The Wide-band Atmospheric Laboratory for Transiting Exoplanet Research (WALTzER) is an ESA F3 mission candidate designed to address this need through simultaneous low-resolution spectroscopy and high-precision photometry of transiting exoplanets. WALTzER covers simultaneously the near-ultraviolet (NUV: 240--325 nm) and visible (VIS: 450--820 nm) bands with two medium resolution spectrographs and the near-infrared (NIR: 900--1700 nm) range with a broadband photometer. We outline the main science drivers and present the mission concept and instrument design. WALTzER's broad, simultaneous wavelength coverage enables the detection and characterisation of the atmospheres of more than 30 gas-rich exoplanets and provides data relevant for a broad range of Solar System and Galactic astrophysics science cases. The payload consists of a 35 cm Cassegrain telescope feeding three co-aligned channels (i.e. NUV, VIS, NIR), sharing a common optical train to minimise instrumental systematics, while maximising observational efficiency.

title: Multi-Method Machine Learning Classification of Astronomical Sources with Rubin Data Previews: a Spectroscopy-Free Approach with DP1 and DP2
background_knowledge: 现代成像巡天每天产生海量天体检测，如何自动、可靠地区分点源与延展源是天文学数据处理的基礎问题之一。点源通常对应恒星、类星体等未分辨天体，延展源则多为星系或星云；这一分类直接影响星系聚类、弱引力透镜、光变选源、测光红移以及后续光谱跟瞄等科学分析。传统上，天文学家依赖形态特征（如 FWHM、半光半径）与多波段颜色进行分离，并以光谱作为最可靠但昂贵的标签来源。Rubin Observatory/LSST 将提供深度的 $ugrizy$ 多波段成像，其 Data Preview 1（DP1）和 Data Preview 2（DP2）用于提前验证数据管线与科学准备。机器学习方法可在无外部光谱条件下，利用测光、形态和辅助星表训练监督分类器；常用指标 macro-F1 能同时衡量两类样本的表现，尤其适合类别不平衡场景。该方向还关注跨天区泛化，因为不同区域的星际消光 $E(B-V)$ 与恒星密度会显著改变特征分布。
contribution: 本文开展了一项多方法机器学习研究，用于 Rubin Observatory Data Preview 1（DP1）和 Data Preview 2（DP2）中点源与延展源的二分类光度分类。整个工作流运行在 Rubin Science Platform 上，使用 DP1 与 DP2 的 $ugrizy$ 测光、DP1 辅助测光红移星表以及 Monster 天体测量与测光参考星表，**完全不依赖外部光谱**。作者在 DP1 最深的 Extended Chandra Deep Field South（ECDFS）场中对六种方法进行基准测试：SVM、Random Forest、XGBoost、k-Nearest Neighbors、人工神经网络以及 soft Voting 集成。在平衡训练子集上，10 折交叉验证 macro-F1 达到 0.95-0.97；在不平衡留出集上，测试 macro-F1 为 0.87-0.92，其中 **Random Forest 与 soft Voting 集成并列最高（0.918）**，且领先方法之间的差异处于统计误差范围内。排列重要性表明 **FWHM 是最主要特征**，六种方法在全星表上的一致率为 79.5%。随后，作者在不重新调参的情况下，将同一管线应用于另外两个具有完整 $ugrizy$ 覆盖和测光红移支持的 DP1 场：Euclid Deep Field South 与 Low Galactic Latitude Field。三个场的 $E(B-V)$ 跨度约为 7 倍、恒星密度跨度约为 10 倍，但 **每个场的核心 macro-F1 仍高于 0.87**。最后，同一管线被应用于四个 DP2 场：ECDFS、COSMOS、EDFS 和 ELAIS-S1。仅使用颜色和形态时，最佳方法的测试 macro-F1 为 0.83-0.88，六种方法在每个星表上的一致率为 77%-86%。**将每波段测光不确定度作为额外特征后，最佳 macro-F1 提升至 ECDFS DP1 约 0.95、ECDFS DP2 约 0.97，并在其他场达到约 0.97-0.98**。
summary: We present a multi-method machine-learning study for the binary photometric classification of point-like and extended sources in the Rubin Observatory Data Preview 1 (DP1) and Data Preview 2 (DP2). The workflow runs on the Rubin Science Platform using DP1 and DP2 ugrizy photometry, the DP1 ancillary photometric-redshift catalog, and the Monster astrometric and photometric reference catalog, without relying on external spectroscopy. Six methods (SVM, Random Forest, XGBoost, k-Nearest Neighbors, an Artificial Neural Network, and a soft Voting ensemble) are benchmarked in the deepest DP1 field, the Extended Chandra Deep Field South. These methods reach 10-fold cross-validation macro-F1 scores of 0.95-0.97 on the balanced training subset and test macro-F1 scores of 0.87-0.92 on the imbalanced held-out set, with RF and the SV ensemble tied at the top (0.918); the differences among the leading methods are within the statistical uncertainty. Permutation importance identifies FWHM as the dominant feature, and the six methods agree on 79.5% of the full catalog. The same pipeline is then applied without retuning the settings to the two other DP1 fields with full ugrizy coverage and photometric-redshift support, Euclid Deep Field South and the Low Galactic Latitude Field. Together, the three fields span a factor of approximately 7 in E(B-V) and approximately 10 in stellar density, yet headline macro-F1 remains above 0.87 in every field. We then apply the same pipeline to four DP2 fields (ECDFS, COSMOS, EDFS, and ELAIS-S1). Using colors and morphology, the best method reaches a test macro-F1 of 0.83 to 0.88 across these fields, and the six methods agree on 77 to 86% of each catalog. Adding the per-band photometric uncertainties as features raises the best macro-F1 to about 0.95 in ECDFS DP1 and 0.97 in ECDFS DP2 (and to approximately 0.97-0.98 in the other fields).

title: The dawn of the first galaxies
background_knowledge: 宇宙黎明（cosmic dawn）是第一批星系形成、组装恒星质量并逐步再电离宇宙的关键时期，对应红移 $z \gtrsim 10$。在标准星系形成框架中，暗物质晕先坍缩，重子气体通过冷却流入晕内，形成冷气体盘或团块，并在致密星际介质（ISM）中坍缩形成恒星；恒星演化、超新星与辐射反馈又会加热、驱动或清空气体，金属与尘埃也在此过程中积累。观测上，JWST 通过静止系紫外连续谱和发射线发现了 $z>10$ 的紫外明亮星系，暗示早期恒星质量增长可能比传统模型预期更快。但要理解这些星系如何获得并消耗冷气体，需要亚毫米波观测：$[OIII]\ 88\,\mu m$ 主要示踪电离气体，而 $[CII]\ 158\,\mu m$ 是中性 ISM 的重要冷却剂和气体质量代理。当前 ALMA 灵敏度使 $[CII]$ 在 $z \sim 8$ 以上难以常规探测，因此早期星系的冷气体含量、ISM 物理条件、金属与尘埃积累以及反馈调控仍是核心未解问题。
contribution: 本文论证，只有 ALMA2040 这类变革性亚毫米波设施才能系统回答第一批星系如何在宇宙黎明组装冷气体并转化为恒星。其核心工作是提出利用 ALMA2040 对 $z>10$ 星系开展 $[CII]$ 系统巡天，从而获得冷气体比例与气体耗尽时标的代表性统计，并诊断早期 ISM 的密度、温度与辐射场。对一个 $z=11.3$ 的模拟星系，**ALMA2040 不仅能够探测，还能在 5 小时内以 $[CII]$ 在约 200 pc 尺度上空间分辨其正在并合的冷气体结构，10 小时内可达到低于 100 pc 的尺度**。ALMA2040 还可同时光谱分辨多条谱线，功能类似积分场光谱，**为打破密度—金属丰度—辐射场简并、绘制 $z>10$ 星系多相 ISM 提供关键诊断**。结合大幅提升的谱线灵敏度与宽瞬时带宽，该设施将把第一批星系的搜寻推进到更早宇宙时代，**使 $[OIII]$ 可探测到 $z \sim 20$**。因此，**ALMA2040 将对理解第一批星系如何在宇宙黎明组装产生变革性影响**。
summary: Understanding how the first galaxies assembled their stellar mass at cosmic dawn is a central frontier of modern astrophysics. JWST has now revealed an unexpected population of ultraviolet-bright galaxies at z>10, whose intense emission points towards a rapid stellar mass growth that challenges current models of early galaxy assembly. Yet, the cold gas fueling this growth remains hidden: current ALMA sensitivity restricts routine detection to only the brightest ionized-gas tracers such as [OIII] 88$μ$m, while [CII] 158$μ$m, a key coolant and gas-mass proxy of the neutral interstellar medium (ISM), is undetected beyond $z\sim8$. This leaves fundamental questions unanswered: how quickly primeval galaxies gathered cold gas and turned it into stars; what physical conditions (density, temperature, radiation field) characterized their ISM; how fast metals and dust built up; and how feedback regulated early gas assembly. Only a transformational sub-millimeter facility like ALMA2040 can address these questions, enabling systematic surveys of [CII] in the first galaxies and providing a representative census of gas fractions and depletion times. A simulated galaxy at $z=11.3$ shows that ALMA2040 not only will detect, but also spatially resolve its merging cold-gas structure in [CII] on $\sim$200 pc scales in 5 hours (below 100 pc in 10 hours). ALMA2040 will also spectrally resolve multiple lines simultaneously, akin to integral-field spectroscopy, providing the key diagnostics needed to break density-metallicity-radiation-field degeneracies and map the multi-phase ISM of z>10 galaxies. The combination of dramatically increased line sensitivity and wide instantaneous bandwidth will push the search for the first galaxies out to the earliest cosmic times, with [OIII] detectable up to $z\sim20$. ALMA2040 will thus be transformative for understanding how the first galaxies assembled at cosmic dawn.

title: Millimetre/Sub-Millimetre SETI: Expanding the Radio Technosignature Parameter Space with ALMA2040
background_knowledge: 射电 SETI 的基本范式是：在射电波段搜寻非自然、窄带或宽带的人为信号，并将其与自然天体辐射区分开。传统上，搜寻集中在厘米波，尤其是所谓“水洞”（water hole，$1.42\text{--}1.66\ \mathrm{GHz}$）——位于 H I 21 cm 线与 OH 18 cm 线之间，曾被设想为星际通信可能偏好的安静频段。毫米/亚毫米天空则几乎未被系统搜寻。其物理背景在于：频率高于约 $35\ \mathrm{GHz}$ 时，星际与行星际介质对传播近乎透明且非色散；地面射频干扰相对稀疏；干涉测量还能通过空间滤波进一步压制残留干扰。同时，天线增益和可用相对带宽通常随频率升高而增大，因此一个优化定向、高数据率链路的文明可能有理由使用该频段——人类通信系统向更高频率迁移即是一例。ALMA 作为毫米/亚毫米干涉阵，以及设想中的 ALMA2040 升级，为把技术痕迹搜寻扩展到这一参数空间提供了新平台。
contribution:
文章以首个 ALMA 技术痕迹巡天（Mason et al. 2025）为基础，提出 ALMA2040 可独特开展的 **四类毫米/亚毫米 SETI 搜寻**：
（i）**窄带搜寻**：使用相位合成、波束形成（phased-up, beamformed）阵列，把 VLA 和 MeerKAT 开创的 commensal 模式扩展到漂移率可达 $\sim 10^3\ \mathrm{Hz\ s^{-1}}$ 的参数区间。
（ii）**宽带聚合泄漏（BRaTs）**：针对 Kardashev Type I 文明，$128$–$512\ \mathrm{GHz}$ 的瞬时带宽可在源上 1 小时积分内给出 $\sim 60\ \mathrm{pc}$ 的探测视界。
（iii）**Dysonian 搜寻**：寻找计算冷废热，即 Slysh haloes；其围绕 M 型矮星的角秒与亚角秒尺度与 ALMA2040 的阵列配置匹配良好。
（iv）**几何不连续**：由掩食巨结构在可见度函数中留下的振铃信号，可通过在毫米/亚毫米 VLBI 阵列中运行的相位 ALMA 探测。\n文章进一步列出相应能力需求：带宽、波束形成、commensal 接入、光谱分辨率与亚秒时间分辨率。其核心信息是：**SETI 应突破厘米波“水洞”传统，系统进入毫米/亚毫米波段**；**ALMA2040 有潜力通过四类技术痕迹搜寻显著扩展可探测参数空间**。
summary: The search for extraterrestrial intelligence (SETI) has been largely concentrated at centimetre wavelengths, and in particular in the 'water hole' (1.42-1.66 GHz) range. The millimetre and sub-millimetre sky is, by contrast, almost entirely unsearched. It also offers some natural advantages: above 35 GHz, the interstellar and interplanetary media are effectively transparent and non-dispersive, terrestrial interference is sparse, and interferometry suppresses what interference remains. Both antenna gain and usable fractional bandwidth increase with frequency, so a civilisation optimising directed, high-data-rate links has advantageous reasons to operate in this regime, as illustrated by the ongoing migration of our own telecommunications systems to much higher frequencies. Building on the first ALMA technosignature survey (Mason et al. 2025), we identify four searches ALMA2040 is uniquely placed to make: (i) narrowband searches using a phased-up, beamformed array, extending the commensal model pioneered for the VLA and MeerKAT into a regime where drift rates reach ~ 103 Hz s^-1; (ii) broadband aggregate leakage (BRaTs) from Kardashev Type I civilisations, for which 128-512 GHz of instantaneous bandwidth places a ~ 60 pc horizon within an integration time of one hour on source; (iii) Dysonian searches for the cold waste heat of computation - Slysh haloes - whose arcsecond and subarcsecond angular scales around M dwarfs are well matched to ALMA2040's array configuration; and (iv) geometric discontinuities imprinted by occulting megastructures, detectable as ringing in the visibility function with a phased ALMA operating in a mm/sub-mm VLBI array. We set out the corresponding requirements: bandwidth, beamforming, commensal access, spectral resolution and sub-second time resolution.

title: Planetary system architectures in the final stages of planet formation
background_knowledge: 行星形成始于原行星盘中尘埃的凝聚与吸积：微米级尘埃通过碰撞黏合形成厘米至米级天体，再通过卵石吸积、星子吸积与巨大撞击等过程成长为行星。原行星盘在数百万年内耗散后，系统并不会立即清空，而是留下行星与大量星子，后者类似于太阳系的 Asteroid Belt 和 Kuiper Belt。此后持续的星子—星子、星子—行星碰撞产生第二代尘埃与气体，形成可观测的 debris disc。研究这一阶段的关键，是把盘外缘或内区星带的空间分布、碰撞速率、尘埃温度与气体含量，同行星的动力学扰动、巨大撞击事件和挥发分输运联系起来。观测上，光学/近红外与（亚）毫米波高分辨率成像可分辨亮星带的环、弧、空隙与团块，ALMA 等设施可探测 CO 等气体；理论则用 N 体与碰撞演化模型反演行星质量、轨道与系统年龄。该领域当前受限于表面亮度：只有最亮、通常较年轻且多位于早型星周围的星带能被详细成像，因此统计样本存在严重选择偏差。
contribution: 论文聚焦行星形成最后阶段，即原行星盘消散后由行星与星子组成的系统，以及碰撞产生的第二代尘埃和气体所构成的 debris disc。作者指出，对这类星带的高分辨率成像可以追踪从 10 到几百 Myr 的类地行星形成关键时期的动力学历史，包括巨大撞击和行星—星带相互作用。当前（亚）毫米波与光学/近红外高分辨率成像已革新了对最亮星子带的认识，揭示出多种结构，其中许多可能留下行星印记；ALMA 也在越来越多的系统中探测到气体。然而，这些结果强烈偏向于最亮、通常较年轻且围绕早型星的星带；即使对这些目标，关键细节也因表面亮度低而在所需分辨率下不可探测。作者提出，未来具备连续谱灵敏度提升一个数量级、谱线灵敏度提升 10 倍的（亚）毫米波设施，将通过首次开展覆盖所有光谱型的暗弱外行星子带统计性巡天、对行星系统内区的行星碰撞进行成像、以及追踪向类地行星输送挥发分的气体测量，**变革我们对晚期行星形成的理解**。这将首次触及暗弱的多数星带，而不再局限于今天可观测的少数明亮盘。
summary: The processes in the last stages of planet formation determine the final assembly and composition of planets. After the protoplanetary discs dissipate, a system of planets and planetesimals -- analogues of the Asteroid and Kuiper Belts -- remains. Ongoing collisions between these bodies produce second-generation dust and gas that form a debris disc. Resolved images of such belts allow us to trace the dynamical history of these systems, including giant impacts and planet-belt interactions, during the crucial era from 10 to a few 100 Myr of terrestrial planet formation. High-resolution mm and optical/near-IR imagers have revolutionised our view of the brightest planetesimal belts, providing first glimpses of diverse structures, many of which show plausible planet imprints, while ALMA has revealed gas in a growing number of systems. Yet these results are strongly biased toward the brightest, mostly young belts around early-type stars, and even for these, crucial details remain undetectable at the required resolution due to their typically low surface brightness. A future (sub-)mm facility with an order of magnitude leap in continuum sensitivity and 10x higher line sensitivity would transform our understanding of late-stage planet formation by enabling the first statistically meaningful surveys of faint outer planetesimal belts across all spectral types, imaging planetary collisions in the inner regions of planetary systems, and gas measurements that trace volatile delivery to terrestrial planets. For the first time, this would reach the faint majority of belts, rather than only the rare bright discs accessible today.

title: Planet formation on solar system scales
background_knowledge: 行星形成发生于年轻恒星周围的原始行星盘中。尘埃颗粒通过碰撞黏并逐步生长为厘米—米级团块，再聚集为公里级星子，星子经由吸积与巨碰撞构建行星胚胎。对于木星这类气态巨行星，主流图像包括核心吸积（先形成约 10 个地球质量的固体核心，再吸积盘内气体）和盘不稳定性（盘自身引力碎裂直接形成巨行星）两条路径。巨行星形成后会与盘中气体和星子发生引力相互作用，通过迁移改变轨道，在盘中打开间隙并激发螺旋密度波，其周围还可能形成卫星系统。观测上，ALMA 等（亚）毫米干涉仪利用连续谱热辐射和分子谱线示踪尘埃、气体及运动学，但直接捕捉仍在形成中的木星级行星及其局部环境极具挑战。理解这一过程对解释太阳系巨行星构型以及系外行星系统多样性至关重要。
contribution: 论文提出，要在太阳系尺度上揭示巨行星形成，需要下一代（亚）毫米干涉仪 ALMA2040。作者论证，与 ALMA 相比，ALMA2040 将连续谱灵敏度提高 $\times 25$、谱线灵敏度提高 $\times 10$，角分辨率提高 $\times 3$；这使其能够探测距离 $150\,{\rm pc}$ 内、围绕类太阳恒星形成的类木行星周围的（亚）毫米辐射，并能对木星级和亚木星级行星与其诞生盘之间的相互作用进行运动学刻画。**ALMA2040 将以前所未有的能力揭示气态巨行星如何刻蚀间隙、吸积物质、形成卫星，并影响共同演化的行星系统结构。**
summary: Giant planets are often regarded as primordial protoplanetary "architects". Their formation and interactions with planetesimals and other planets during and after the protoplanetary disc phase are key to setting the blueprint of the planetary systems we observe today. Catching nascent gas giants is our best opportunity to uncover these crucial steps in the planet formation process and shed light on the origins of our own solar system. Over the last decade, ALMA has revolutionised our understanding of planet formation; still, detecting signatures of Jupiter-like planets has remained out of reach. We argue that ALMA2040, a next-generation sub(mm) interferometer with improved sensitivity ($\times25$ in the continuum and $\times10$ for line emission) and a $\times3$ higher angular resolution compared to ALMA, will be sensitive to (sub)mm emission around a forming Jupiter-like planet orbiting a Sun-like star within $150\,{\rm pc}$ and allow kinematically characterising interactions of Jovian and sub-Jovian planets with their natal disc. ALMA2040 will provide unique and unprecedented insights into how gas giants carve gaps, accrete material, form satellites, and affect the architectures of their co-evolving planetary systems.

title: The Forgetful Black Hole: Memory Burden and Hysteresis in Hawking Evaporation
background_knowledge: 黑洞热力学与 Hawking 辐射是量子引力与高能天体物理交叉的核心问题之一。1970 年代建立的半经典理论表明，黑洞并非只进不出；视界附近的量子涨落可使其发射近似热的 Hawking 辐射，其温度 $T_H \sim 1/M$ 与质量成反比，Bekenstein-Hawking 熵则正比于视界面积。半经典图像下，黑洞会缓慢失去质量并最终蒸发；寿命对质量极敏感，低质量原初黑洞的寿命 $\tau \sim M^3$ 可短于宇宙年龄。然而，若蒸发完全热化，初始量子信息似乎会丢失，这与量子力学幺正性冲突，即黑洞信息悖论。Page 时间之后，辐射应逐渐携带信息，这要求黑洞内部或近视界区域储存大量信息，并对后续蒸发产生反作用。memory-burden 情景认为，维持这些已储存量子信息并非免费；随着黑洞蒸发，记忆成本会压低 Hawking 发射率。若负担足够强，黑洞可能不会按半经典预期爆炸式结束，而变成长寿命状态或有效 remnant，从而显著改变原初黑洞（PBH）的丰度、演化与可观测信号。该领域常结合半经典引力、量子信息、有效场论与全息思想，通过标度分析、玩具模型和现象学约束来检验蒸发终态与记忆效应；若系统演化依赖历史而非仅依赖当前质量，还会出现滞后（hysteresis）现象。
contribution: 本文重新审视 memory-burden 情景，核心问题是：信息保留在什么条件下会变成真正影响蒸发动力学的负担。作者先对固定分数质量损失下的增量记忆累积给出一般标度条件，并得到一个条件性 no-go 结果：**若记忆沉积被熵压低、均值为零，且积分关联为次广延，则通过未放大的累积与有界反馈，无法产生量级为一的光度修正**。随后，文章提炼出动力学记忆的三个必要条件：**过去的记录必须被写入、被保留，并反馈耦合到后续蒸发**，并用具体玩具模型展示两类结果：黑洞寿命被延长但仍有限，或渐近逼近一个有限质量态，即有效 remnant。文章还区分了 kinetic-memory、thermodynamic-memory 与 spectral-memory 三类可能的 memory-burden 机制。特别地，作者证明，**一个独立演化的记忆变量可产生蒸发—吸积滞后：黑洞回到相同质量时，可拥有不同的保留记忆，因而具有不同的光度**，这种历史依赖性可能影响原初黑洞现象学。最后，文章简要讨论 “merger rejuvenation” 的可能性，即黑洞并合可能重组或重置有效记忆态。
summary: The memory-burden scenario of black hole evaporation proposes that Hawking emission may become increasingly suppressed as maintaining stored quantum information becomes dynamically costly. In this work, we revisit this scenario and investigate the conditions under which information retention can produce a genuine dynamical burden. We derive general scaling conditions for incremental memory accumulation at a fixed fractional mass loss and establish a conditional no-go result: entropy-suppressed, zero-mean deposits with subextensive integrated correlations cannot produce an order-one luminosity modification through unamplified accumulation and bounded feedback. We identify three essential requirements for dynamical memory: a record of the past must be written, retained, and coupled back to subsequent evaporation. We illustrate these requirements with concrete toy models that exhibit either a prolonged but finite black hole lifetime or an asymptotically approached finite-mass state (an effective remnant). We further distinguish kinetic-memory, thermodynamic-memory, and spectral-memory sub-categories of possible memory-burden mechanisms. In particular, we demonstrate that an independently evolving memory variable can generate evaporation-accretion hysteresis, such that a black hole returning to the same mass may possess a different retained memory and consequently a different luminosity. This history dependence may have implications for primordial black hole phenomenology. Finally, we briefly discuss the possibility of "merger rejuvenation", in which black hole mergers reorganize or reset the effective memory state.

title: Stellar Mass Census of $S^4G$ Local Bars
background_knowledge: 星系盘中的棒（bar）是常见的非轴对称恒星结构，由盘内恒星轨道共振与自引力不稳定性形成。棒能够重新分配角动量，驱动气体向星系中心输运，进而触发核星暴、形成核球和核星盘，是星系长期演化（secular evolution）的关键通道。研究棒的性质通常依赖多波段测光图像分解，将星系分解为盘、核球、棒、核点源等成分，并由测光质量比或颜色推断恒星质量分布。Spitzer 空间望远镜在 3.6 和 4.5 $\mu$m 的红外成像可较有效地示踪年老恒星的光度质量，受尘埃和近期恒星形成影响较小。$S^4G$ 巡天（Spitzer Survey of Stellar Structure in Galaxies）为近邻盘星系提供了理想样本。通过测量棒质量、棒长度、棒与总恒星质量之比，以及核球 Sérsic 指数等参数，可以检验棒的生长是否取决于星系质量、内部结构和形成历史，并区分不同演化路径。
contribution: 作者对来自 $S^4G$ 的 344 个有棒星系，在 3.6 和 4.5 $\mu$m 两个中红外波段开展 GALFITM 多波段二维分解，估计盘、核球、棒和核点源各结构成分的恒星质量，并考察棒性质与星系整体特征的相关性。最终模型包含每个星系 2 至 4 个成分，最简构型（盘与棒）通常对应低质量系统。研究发现：**质量更大、具有显著核球的星系倾向于拥有更高质量的棒，并具有更高的棒与星系总恒星质量比中位数**；这些核球的 Sérsic 指数一般低于 2，符合核星盘的光度特征。在固定星系质量下比较相对棒长时，分布呈双峰：**有核球的星系比无核球星系拥有相对更长的棒**。这些结果可能源于不同演化路径，并与不同的盘形成时期有关，使棒有更多时间在尺寸和质量上增长。该研究表明，**棒演化可能在不同星系质量区间遵循不同路径，并可能受长期演化过程和环境效应影响**。
summary: Bars are stellar structures commonly found in disk galaxies and important agents of secular evolution. Quantifying the stellar mass content of bars provides a physically motivated approach to assess how bar growth depends on galaxy mass and internal structure. We perform a GALFITM multi-band mid-infrared two-dimensional decomposition of 344 barred galaxies from the Spitzer Survey of Stellar Structure in Galaxies ($S^4G$) in the 3.6 and 4.5 $μ$m bands. We estimate the stellar mass associated with each structural component (i.e., disk, bulge, bar, and nuclear point source) and investigate how bar properties correlate with global galaxy characteristics. Our final models consist of 2-4 components per galaxy, with the simplest configuration (disk + bar) typically associated with low-mass systems. We find that more massive galaxies with prominent bulges host more massive bars and higher median bar-to-total stellar mass ratios. These bulges generally present Sérsic indices below 2, consistent with a photometric signature of nuclear stellar disks. Additionally, when we consider the relative bar lengths at a fixed galaxy mass, we find a bimodal distribution where galaxies with bulges host relatively longer bars compared to their bulgeless counterparts. These findings could be the result of different evolutionary paths, possibly linked to different disk formation epochs, allowing bars more time to grow in size and mass. Our study indicates that bar evolution may follow distinct pathways across different galaxy mass regimes, and is likely influenced by secular processes and environmental effects.

title: Breaking de Sitter Symmetry with Cosmic Topology: Cosmological Role of Infrared Vacuum Freedom
background_knowledge: 在早期宇宙与弯曲时空量子场论中，常以 de Sitter 时空作为暴胀或加速膨胀的近似背景。其空间截面通常默认具有平凡拓扑，并利用全局 de Sitter 对称性选择 Bunch-Davies 真空。该真空使两点关联函数的短距离行为与平坦空间一致，即满足 Hadamard 条件，同时消除或固定红外行为。Hadamard 条件本质上是局部的，只约束短距离发散结构；而空间拓扑等全局性质可能破坏 de Sitter 不变性。若空间截面紧致且非平凡，例如三维环面 $T^3$ 时，动量模式会离散化，零模 $k=0$ 可能不再能按传统论证简单丢弃。半经典引力中，量子场应力能量张量 $\langle T_{\mu\nu}\rangle$ 作为爱因斯坦方程的源；若其中出现状态方程 $P=-\rho$ 的贡献，它就像有效宇宙学常数，可驱动 de Sitter 膨胀。此领域的研究范式包括：在给定背景上量子化场、实施重整化、检查真空选择与红外自由度，并评估它们对宇宙膨胀的反馈。
contribution: 论文研究 de Sitter 时空且空间截面为环面的标量场，聚焦非平凡拓扑对真空选择与红外自由度的影响。作者指出，保证短距离结构与平坦空间相同的 Hadamard 条件是局部的，因此天然不受紧致化影响；但环面等同会破坏全局 de Sitter 不变性，并改变红外扇区，从而移除通常用于丢弃零模贡献的对称性论证。论文把剩余零模自由度视为一种由拓扑诱导的有效源，并在半经典框架下分析它对暴胀 de Sitter 膨胀的作用。核心结果是：对于无质量标量，零模扇区可以对应力能量张量贡献满足状态方程 $P=-\rho$ 的项，其行为如同宇宙学常数。由此，**驱动早期宇宙 de Sitter 阶段的源不必只由作用量中的局部项决定，也可以依赖量子态的红外结构**。非平凡拓扑作为 de Sitter 对称性破缺的具体实现，把原本未定的真空红外自由度转化为与半经典膨胀直接相关的贡献；**该机制可能还可应用于当前宇宙的加速膨胀**。
summary: When spatial sections of spacetime are topologically nontrivial, the symmetry arguments usually used to choose the Bunch-Davies vacuum are no longer guaranteed to apply. We study this problem for a scalar field on de Sitter spacetime with toroidal spatial sections. The Hadamard conditions, which ensure the same short-distance structure as in flat space, are local and naturally insensitive to the compactification. By contrast, we find that the infrared sector is affected by the toroidal identifications that break global de Sitter invariance, thereby removing the usual argument for discarding zero-mode contributions. We treat the remaining zero-mode freedom as an effective topology-induced source and analyze its effects on an inflationary de Sitter expansion within a semiclassical setting. We show that, for a massless scalar, the zero-mode sector can contain a contribution to the stress-energy tensor with equation of state $P=-ρ$, behaving as a cosmological constant. Thus, the source driving an early-Universe de Sitter phase need not be determined solely by local terms in the action, but can also depend on the infrared structure of the quantum state. Nontrivial topology, as a concrete realization of de Sitter symmetry violation, turns the otherwise-unfixed infrared freedom in vacuum selection to a contribution directly relevant to the semiclassical expansion. This contribution could potentially be applicable to the current accelerated expansion of the Universe.

title: A New Method for Constraining 3D Exoplanet Atmospheres: Application to WASP-94A b's Panchromatic Spectrum
background_knowledge:
系外行星大气研究正从一维球对称图像走向三维、肢体分辨的图像。凌星透射光谱是探测系外行星大气的主要方法：行星经过恒星前方时，一部分星光沿行星大气的临边方向穿过，并在波长依赖的吸收和散射过程中被衰减，因此凌星深度随波长变化，携带大气温度、化学成分以及云和霾的信息。传统反演通常假设大气球对称，即晨侧（morning limb）和昏侧（evening limb）具有相同结构。然而，真实行星大气受昼夜受热差异、大气环流、风、云和光化学等影响，可能呈现临边不对称；JWST 等高精度观测已越来越多地发现晨侧与昏侧透射深度不同的证据。
\n当前限制在于解释这些观测。常用做法是分别拟合两肢的透射深度，但两个肢体的透射深度因总凌星深度守恒和几何参数耦合而高度反相关；若将其视为独立测量，可能导致分子丰度反演出现强偏置（可达 $3\sigma$）。因此，该领域需要能利用独立观测量、降低参数相关性并稳健反演肢体分辨大气性质的推断框架。
contribution:
本文提出一套新的推断框架，利用肢体不对称的时间信号而非直接拟合肢体分辨凌星深度来约束三维系外行星大气。该信号是凌星中时刻随波长发生的微小移动，即时间移动谱（time-shift spectrum）；它携带肢体不对称信息，可从已有光变曲线中用球对称凌星模型测量，并且与球对称平均透射深度不相关。将透射谱与时间移动谱联合拟合，并为晨侧和昏侧分别设置独立大气柱，便可以从两类独立测量中反演肢体分辨性质。作者表明，相比当前领域采用的其他备选方法中表现最佳者，该框架将反演分子丰度的均方误差降低约 $30-50$ 倍，并将丰度精度提高约 $3-6$ 倍。
\n将该框架应用于 WASP-94A b 后，本文给出其 0.8–5 μm 的全景肢体分辨光谱，联合了 NIRISS/SOSS 与 NIRSpec/G395H 观测。**该行星晨侧在整个波段均被气溶胶遮蔽，而昏侧可约束 H$_2$O、CO$_2$、CO 和 H$_2$S 的丰度；在 1 mbar 处测得肢体间温差为 $415\pm58$ K。肢体分辨分析得到 $\mathrm{[M/H]}=+0.32^{+0.11}_{-0.11}$ 和 $\mathrm{C/O}=0.724^{+0.013}_{-0.013}$，与宿主恒星一致。**
summary: A growing number of transiting exoplanets exhibit spectroscopic evidence that their leading and trailing limbs differ. Interpreting these observations is now the limiting step. The standard approach of fitting limb-resolved transit depths results in highly anti-correlated transit depths, and treating them as independent measurements can result in strongly biased ($3σ$) retrieved molecular abundances. We present an inference framework that avoids these correlations by using the temporal signature of limb asymmetry instead. This wavelength-dependent shift in mid-transit time, or `time-shift spectrum', carries the limb-asymmetry information, is measurable from existing light curves with a spherically symmetric transit model, and is uncorrelated with the spherically-averaged transit depth. Simultaneously fitting the resulting transmission and time-shift spectrum with an independent atmospheric column for each limb enables the retrieval of limb-resolved properties from two independent measurements. We demonstrate that this approach reduces the mean squared error on the retrieved molecular abundances by factors of $\sim30-50$ relative to next best of the alternative approaches currently adopted in the field, and improves retrieved abundance precision by $\sim3-6\times$. We apply the framework to WASP-94A b and present its panchromatic limb-resolved spectrum, spanning 0.8-5~$μ$m and combining NIRISS/SOSS and NIRSpec/G395H observations. The planet's morning limb remains aerosol-obscured across this entire range, while its evening limb constrains the abundances of H$_2$O, CO$_2$, CO, and H$_2$S. We measure a limb-to-limb temperature difference of $415\pm58$~K at 1~mbar. This limb-resolved analysis finds [M/H]=+0.32$^{+0.11}_{-0.11}$ and C/O=0.724$^{+0.013}_{-0.013}$, consistent with the host star.

title: A Sample of Thick-Disk Stars Hosting Hot Jupiters
background_knowledge:
热木星是轨道周期通常短于约 10 天、质量与木星相当或更大的巨行星。其形成位置一般认为在雪线之外，随后通过盘迁移、引力散射或潮汐作用等机制进入近距离轨道。理解热木星的诞生与长期演化，需要把行星性质与其宿主星的年龄、化学组成和运动学归属联系起来。
\n银河系恒星盘可粗略分为薄盘与厚盘：薄盘多为低 $\mathrm{[\alpha/Fe]}$、较年轻、金属丰度分布较宽，厚盘则多为高 $\mathrm{[\alpha/Fe]}$、年龄常大于 8–10 Gyr，反映了早期快照式核心坍缩超新星增丰。化学动力学分类利用 $\mathrm{[\alpha/Fe]}$ 与 $\mathrm{[Fe/H]}$ 等丰度把恒星回溯到不同银河环境。行星发生率与宿主星金属丰度、质量、年龄及环境有关，但热木星在厚盘等古老、高 $\alpha$ 环境中的分布仍缺乏大样本统计。高分辨率光谱可给出恒星参数与化学丰度，Gaia 天体测量与多波段测光则约束半径、光度与运动学，从而支持对宿主星族群和行星形成环境的系统比较。
contribution:
本文对 268 颗已确认或候选的凌星热木星宿主星进行均匀分析，宿主星有效温度范围为 $4800\ \mathrm{K} < T_{\mathrm{eff}} < 6200\ \mathrm{K}$。作者结合高分辨率 TRES 光谱、Gaia、2MASS 和 WISE 测光以及 Gaia 天体测量，测定 $T_{\mathrm{eff}}$、$\log g$、$R_{\mathrm{star}}$、$\mathrm{[\alpha/Fe]}$ 和 $\mathrm{[Fe/H]}$，并据此把恒星分为银河系低 $\mathrm{[\alpha/Fe]}$ 薄盘、高 $\mathrm{[\alpha/Fe]}$ 厚盘和归属不明确的中间族群。研究识别出 2 颗已确认热木星（WASP-81 b 和 TOI-5322 b）与 3 颗候选热木星（TOI-3118.01、TOI-2728.01 和 TOI-5781.01），它们绕转的是此前未被识别的高 $\mathrm{[\alpha/Fe]}$ 厚盘成员。
\n比较三个族群中已确认行星的性质后，作者发现两个可能差异：**高 $\mathrm{[\alpha/Fe]}$ 确认行星以及 11 颗归属不明确族群确认行星中的 8 颗，其质量均低于低 $\mathrm{[\alpha/Fe]}$ 行星质量中位数**；同时，**高 $\mathrm{[\alpha/Fe]}$ 或归属不明确族群的确认行星均无短于 2.7 d 的轨道周期，而低 $\mathrm{[\alpha/Fe]}$ 族群中有 22% 的行星满足这一条件**。这些差异可能源于不同银河环境中巨行星形成过程的差异、演化效应，或高、低 $\mathrm{[\alpha/Fe]}$ 族群恒星性质的不同。该目录是目前最大的、经化学证认的高 $\mathrm{[\alpha/Fe]}$ 厚盘确认与候选热木星宿主星样本。这些年龄大于 8 Gyr 的古老系统，有望帮助理解热木星形成如何依赖银河环境，以及其轨道在极长时间尺度上如何演化。
summary: We present a homogeneous analysis of 268 confirmed and candidate transiting hot-Jupiter host stars with 4800K < Teff < 6200K. We combine high-resolution TRES spectra, Gaia, 2MASS and WISE photometry, and Gaia astrometry to determine these stars' Teff, log g, Rstar, [alpha/Fe] and [Fe/H]. Based on their [alpha/Fe] and [Fe/H], we classify the stars as members of the Milky Way's low-[alpha/Fe] thin disk, high-[alpha/Fe] thick disk or an ambiguous intermediate population. We identify two confirmed hot Jupiters (WASP-81 b and TOI-5322 b) and three candidate hot Jupiters (TOI-3118.01, TOI-2728.01, and TOI-5781.01) as orbiting previously-unrecognized members of the high-alpha thick disk. We compare the properties of the confirmed planets in the three populations and note two indications of a potential difference between the populations: both high-[alpha/Fe] confirmed planets and eight out of the eleven ambiguous-disk confirmed planets are less massive than the median low-[alpha/Fe] planet, and none of our high-[alpha/Fe] or ambiguous confirmed planets have orbital periods shorter than 2.7 d, when 22% of our low-[alpha/Fe] population do. These differences may reflect variations in giant-planet formation across galactic environments, evolutionary effects, or differing stellar properties between the high- and low-[alpha/Fe] populations. Our catalog is the largest sample of chemically-identified high-[alpha/Fe] thick-disk confirmed and candidate hot-Jupiter host stars. These ancient systems, with ages > 8 Gyr, may allow for a better understanding of how the formation of hot Jupiters depends on galactic environment, and how their orbits evolve over very long time scales.

title: Properties and limitations of linear models for mutual coupling in 21 cm arrays
background_knowledge: 21 cm 宇宙学通过观测红移后的中性氢 21 cm 谱线，研究宇宙黑暗时代之后、宇宙黎明与再电离时期（EoR）星系际介质的演化。对应频段约 $50$–$200$ MHz，主流设备包括 HERA、LOFAR、MWA、PAPER 以及未来的 SKA-Low 等低频射电干涉阵列。其核心观测挑战是：银河系同步辐射、自由—自由辐射和河外射电源等前景，比宇宙学 21 cm 信号亮若干量级，但前景在频率上相对平滑，而宇宙学信号沿频率快速变化。常用功率谱和前景避让（EoR window）技术分离两者，因此要求仪器波束具有极低的频率色差并且能被精确标定。互耦合是紧密阵列中的主要系统误差之一：相邻天线通过近场电磁作用相互散射和再辐射，使有效波束随频率、方向和阵列环境变化，从而把亮前景泄漏到原本干净的区域。传统缓解方法把耦合近似为未耦合信号经邻近馈源再辐射后的线性叠加，并据此扣除；但实测残差提示该近似不完整。理解这一问题需要天线散射理论中的模式分解：一部分耦合可由平移的孤立天线响应构造，称为天线模；剩余部分称为结构模。全息后向投影等孔径场诊断方法也用于直观理解波束扰动。
contribution: 论文基于天线散射理论，把低频阵列中的互耦合分解为天线模（由平移的孤立响应构造，理论上可被线性组合模型扣除）与结构模（剩余部分）。对 37 单元六边形阵列中类似 HERA 的馈源与碟形天线做全波模拟，发现天线模仅占波束扰动功率的约 **1%**，表明线性模型的缓解能力有限。不过，有两个效应能显著改善抑制效果：第一，对波束做互相关并按天空加权会改变各模的相对重要性，在模拟可见度中修正天线模可去除 **超过一半** 的耦合功率；第二，放宽再辐射所强加的系数关系后，线性修正也能去除结构模耦合。在无噪声、完全冗余阵列模拟中，基于波束的修正可将耦合功率降低 **一个数量级以上**。直接拟合已知的孤立可见度可在拟合场中进一步压低残差，但该目标在观测中通常不可得。因此实际修正需要额外约束，以在保留宇宙学信号的同时把未知天空与耦合分离。论文还提出了将全息后向投影推广到耦合波束的方法，在孔径平面上为这些扰动提供直观图像。
summary: Mutual coupling between elements of low-frequency arrays is a leading systematic for 21 cm cosmology, leaking bright foregrounds into otherwise clean regions of the power spectrum. Many mitigation models describe coupling as a linear combination of uncoupled signals re-radiated from neighboring feeds, but data suggest additional mechanisms. Inspired by antenna scattering theory, we decompose coupling into an antenna mode, constructed from translated isolated responses and expected to be removable by linear combination models, and a structural mode, the remainder. Full-wave simulations of HERA-like feeds and dishes in a 37-element hexagonal array show that the antenna mode accounts for only about 1% of the beam perturbation power, suggesting limited scope for mitigation with linear models. Two effects nevertheless lead to substantially better suppression. First, correlating beams and weighting them by the sky changes the modes' relative importance: correcting the antenna mode can remove more than half of the coupling power in simulated visibilities. Second, relaxing the coefficient relationships imposed by re-radiation allows linear corrections to remove structural-mode coupling too. Beam-derived corrections can reduce coupling power by over an order of magnitude in our noiseless simulations of perfectly redundant arrays. Fitting directly to known isolated visibilities reduces residuals further on the fitted field, but this target is generally unavailable in observations. Practical correction therefore requires additional constraints to separate the unknown sky from coupling while preserving the cosmological signal. We introduce an extension of holographic back-projection to coupled beams, providing an intuitive picture of these perturbations in the aperture plane.

title: The Radius-Luminosity Relationship for Active Galactic Nuclei with Hierarchical Bayesian Reverberation Mapping
background_knowledge: 活跃星系核（AGN）由中心超大质量黑洞（SMBH）吸积供能，其光学/紫外连续谱来自吸积盘，而宽发射线来自黑洞附近高速运动的宽线区（BLR）气体。当连续谱光度发生变化后，BLR 气体被重新电离并产生响应，因此宽发射线的变化会滞后于连续谱变化。若把响应时标近似为光穿越 BLR 的时间，则滞后 $\tau \approx R_{\mathrm{BLR}}/c$，由此可测得 BLR 半径；再结合宽线速度宽度 $v$，可由维里估计推得黑洞质量 $M_{\mathrm{BH}} = f \frac{R_{\mathrm{BLR}} v^2}{G}$。大量 Reverberation Mapping 观测发现 BLR 半径与 AGN 光度之间存在半径-光度关系（R-L relation），常近似为 $R_{\mathrm{BLR}} \propto L^{1/2}$，这使单次测光加谱线宽度即可估计黑洞质量。该领域需要多年、多目标、高 cadence 的光变监测，但大规模巡天常受采样不足、季节窗口导致的混叠、光变曲线质量参差以及不同统计框架不一致等问题困扰；层级贝叶斯方法则可把单个 AGN 的滞后与总体分布联合建模，在总体超参数层面同时推断。
contribution: 该工作提出一个面向大型巡天的端到端贝叶斯框架，可在拟合大规模滞后（lag）的同时拟合总体模型，例如半径-光度关系，并采用数值上可处理的形式。该方法可视为对以往 stacking 与质量筛选流程的统计和数值鲁棒推广，能够完全边缘化数据不确定性和数据质量；在扩展到更大巡天时保持数值稳定，并可成为任意大规模 AGN 时间序列观测的贝叶斯总体建模基础。应用于 OzDES 样本时，作者证明新方法 **对 R-L 关系等总体性质的约束能力提高超过一倍**，**恢复的滞后与黑洞质量数目增加约一个数量级**；从传统方法的 24 个高质量滞后恢复，提升到约 297 的有效样本量，同时 **对随机偶然的假阳性测量具有稳健性**。
summary: Reverberation mapping of active galactic nuclei uses the time taken for variability to travel through the system as a measure of system size, with this size being used to inform estimates of the mass of the central black hole, a technique that has graduated to an industrial-scale effort in recent decades. Such large target-count, multi-year surveys have been consistently undercut by poor light curve quality and the aliasing problems of seasonal observations. These impacts compound with statistical approaches that are not consistent between works and sometimes combine inconsistent statistical frameworks. Here, we present a new end-to-end Bayesian framework for fitting lags at scale in large surveys, simultaneous with the fitting of population models such as the radius-luminosity relation, and formulated in a numerically tractable way. This procedure is a statistically and numerically robust generalisation of the stacking and quality cut procedures of past works, fully marginalising over data uncertainty and data quality. Our approach remains numerically stable when scaling to larger surveys, and can act as a basis for any Bayesian population modelling of large sets of AGN time series observations. Applied to the OzDES sample, we demonstrate that this new approach yields more than double the constraining power on population-level properties like the R-L relationship, and an order-of-magnitude increase in the number of recovered lags and masses. With this method, we go from 24 high quality lag recoveries with traditional methods to a new effective sample size of ~297, all while being robust against random chance false positive measurements.

title: Disentangling Multi-epoch Single-lined Binary Star Spectra to Reveal Interstellar Medium Features via MCMC
background_knowledge: 弥漫星际带（Diffuse Interstellar Bands, DIBs）是广泛存在于星际介质（ISM）中的光学至近红外吸收特征，其载体至今未被完全确认，通常被认为可能与大型含碳分子、多环芳烃（PAHs）等复杂有机/碳质物种有关。DIB 的研究连接了星际化学、尘埃与气体分布以及银河系星际环境诊断，是理解 ISM 物化条件与化学演化的重要探针。实际观测中，DIB 常叠加在背景恒星光谱上，尤其当恒星较冷时，密集的恒星吸收线会严重污染 DIB 测量；传统做法依赖模板匹配扣除恒星成分，其精度受限于模板质量、恒星参数失配、谱线展宽与视向速度（RV）变化等因素。双星/多 epoch 光谱提供了一个天然优势：恒星谱线随双星轨道运动发生 RV 位移，而 DIB 位于星际介质静止系中基本不动。因此，利用时序光谱可把位移的恒星线和不动的星际线在参数空间中分离。贝叶斯 MCMC 方法则能同时建模两类成分并给出参数后验分布，适用于 LAMOST 等时域光谱巡天中的大规模、低至中分辨率数据。
contribution: 论文提出了一种不依赖恒星模板的算法 MCMC-RVSD，将单线双星的多 epoch 光谱中恒星谱线与星际 DIB 同时拟合：恒星线随轨道运动产生 RV 位移，DIB 则保持在静止系，因而可被联合分离。作者用模拟 LAMOST 中分辨率观测验证方法，能够精确恢复 DIB $\lambda 6614$ 参数，**在 $R=3000$-$7500$ 范围内可靠工作**。随后将该方法应用于 LAMOST 中分辨率巡天中的 434 个真实双星源，并引入 MCMC 自相关时间 $\tau_{\mathrm{DIB}}$ 评估拟合质量。结果显示，**RV 跨度 $>20\ \mathrm{km\ s^{-1}}$ 是成功分离谱线的首要驱动因素**，更密集的轨道采样可进一步改善结果；在 $\mathrm{SNR}>50$ 与 RV 误差 $<5\ \mathrm{km\ s^{-1}}$ 的典型观测条件下算法保持稳健。理想条件下，其参数不确定度显著小于传统模板匹配。该算法还可通过调整模型与先验处理多恒星谱线污染、非高斯 DIB 及其他 DIB，**为时域光谱巡天中的星际特征精确测量提供可靠、通用的工具**。
summary: Diffuse Interstellar Bands (DIBs) are interstellar absorption features with unidentified carriers in the optical and near-infrared spectra. When observed in cool star spectra, they are heavily contaminated by stellar lines. Traditional methods rely on template matching to remove the stellar component, but their accuracy is fundamentally limited by template quality. We present a template-independent algorithm that separates stellar and interstellar features in binary star spectra by exploiting orbital motion: stellar lines shift with changing radial velocity (RV), whereas DIBs remain stationary in the rest frame. The MCMC-RVSD algorithm, implemented as an RV-based Bayesian Markov Chain Monte Carlo framework, fits both components simultaneously. We validated our approach by applying it to mock spectra simulating LAMOST medium-resolution observations. The method precisely recovers the parameters of DIB $λ$6614. It performs reliably for spectra with $R=3000$-$7500$. We applied the method to 434 real binary sources from the LAMOST medium-resolution survey and introduced the MCMC autocorrelation time ($τ_{\mathrm{DIB}}$) to assess the fit quality. Our analysis shows that an RV span $>20$ km s$^{-1}$ is the primary driver of successful line separation. Denser orbital sampling provides further improvement, and the algorithm remains robust against typical observational noise at SNR $>50$ and RV errors $<5$ km s$^{-1}$. Under ideal conditions, our approach yields significantly smaller parameter uncertainties than traditional template matching. Additionally, the MCMC-RVSD algorithm can also handle multi-stellar line contamination, non-Gaussian DIBs and other DIBs by adjusting model and prior settings. This algorithm provides a reliable, general-purpose tool for precise measurement of interstellar features in time-domain spectroscopic surveys.

title: Modified hydrogen recombination rate due to non-Hubble redshift effects
background_knowledge:
宇宙微波背景（CMB）是早期宇宙热大爆炸冷却后留下的黑体辐射，其温度与偏振各向异性记录了复合时期（$z \sim 1100$）及之后的光子-重子等离子体演化。标准图像中，氢原子在约 3000 K 时通过电子与质子复合形成中性氢，光子退耦并自由传播；复合过程的细节由非平衡 Boltzmann 方程描述，需要同时跟踪自由电子分数、激发态氢原子能级布居、Lyman-$\alpha$ 共振线辐射的发射与吸收、双光子衰变以及宇宙膨胀导致的红移。Lyman-$\alpha$ 光子能否逃逸共振线，直接影响复合速率和最终电子分数，进而改变 CMB 声学峰的位置与高度。
\n标准复合计算通常假设共振线光子的红移主要来自宇宙膨胀，即哈勃红移；但若中性氢原子具有热运动，共振散射中的多普勒频移也可能帮助光子离开共振线核心，形成额外的逃逸通道。此类微观效应若被忽略，会系统性地偏置由 CMB 推断的宇宙学参数。当前宇宙学的一个核心问题是不同观测给出的参数存在张力，例如本地距离阶梯测量的 $H_0$ 高于 $\Lambda$CDM 与 CMB 推断值，弱引力透镜和星系团计数给出的 $S_8$ 低于 CMB 推断值，因此修改复合历史和早期物理过程成为缓解这些张力的可能途径。研究范式通常是先构造含新物理的复合或热历史模型，再计算 CMB 功率谱，最后用 Planck 等数据做参数推断并与标准模型比较。
contribution: 本文重新审视标准氢复合计算，并研究一种可能对 Lyman-$\alpha$ 光子逃逸共振线的速率引入修正的机制。作者发现，Lyman-$\alpha$ 线光子与运动的中性氢原子之间的相互作用可以成为这种修正的来源。对修改模型的 CMB 数据分析**倾向于支持存在非哈勃红移效应**，并且与标准 $\Lambda$CDM 模型相比，**偏好略高的 $H_0$、较小的 $\Omega_m$ 与 $S_8$，以及较小的标量谱指数 $n_s$**。
summary: The accumulation of observational data in recent years has led to a peculiar situation in which measurements of the cosmological parameters made by various collaborations and using different methods yield significantly different values. A solution to this problem may be found by modifying the models used to obtain these values. In this work, we revisit the standard approach to the recombination calculation and investigate a mechanism that can introduce corrections to the rate at which Lyman-alpha photons escape the resonance line. We find that interactions of Lyman-alpha line photons with moving neutral hydrogen atoms can become a source of such a correction. An analysis of CMB data for the modified model favors the existence of a non-Hubble redshift effect and prefers slightly higher values of $H_0$ and smaller values of $Ω_m$ and $S_8$ compared to the standard $Λ$CDM model, as well as a smaller value of the scalar spectrum index $n_s$.

title: Polarization Properties of Thomson-Scattering Triaxial Ellipsoids
background_knowledge: 偏振测量是天文观测中约束天体几何、磁场与散射过程的重要手段。在光学薄、电子散射主导的光球中，连续谱偏振主要由 Thomson 散射产生：电子对入射光子散射后，出射光的偏振状态与散射角、电子柱密度及光源几何有关。若光球是理想球对称的，来自不同区域的偏振贡献因投影对称而相互抵消，净偏振通常为零；一旦光球因快速旋转、双星相互作用、非球对称爆炸或强激波而变形，不同视线方向上投影面积与散射角不再对称，就会产生可观测的连续谱偏振。研究这类偏振常以椭球体（spheroid）或三轴椭球体作为光球几何近似，用 Stokes 参数 $Q$ 和 $U$ 描述线偏振，并计算偏振度 $P$ 与偏振角随视角 $i$、轴比和形变程度的变化。该方向属于瞬变源几何诊断与辐射转移偏振学的交叉领域，常用于超新星、潮汐瓦解事件、千新星及伽马射线暴等爆发机制研究。
contribution: 论文系统计算了椭球光球由 Thomson 散射产生的连续谱偏振，覆盖比以往更广的形变参数与观测视角，并把计算推广到三轴椭球体。核心发现包括：**强形变椭球体的偏振度随视角呈非单调变化**，这一行为在此前研究中被忽略；**三轴椭球体产生更丰富的偏振特征**，包括偏振度与偏振角对视线方向的复杂依赖。作者指出，这些定性行为可从近 edge-on 视角下表面元的投影面积来理解，因为该几何下局部偏振最强，主导整体积分信号。该工作为光球几何如何影响偏振提供了简单物理图像，有助于利用偏振观测约束瞬变源及遥远天体的几何与爆炸机制，并承诺将计算结果公开以供后续研究使用。
summary: Polarimetry is a powerful tool for constraining the geometry of distant astrophysical objects. Continuum polarization induced by Thomson scattering can probe the photospheric geometry of transients and provide insight into their explosion mechanisms. We systematically study continuum polarization from spheroids over a broader range of deformations and viewing angles than considered previously, and generalize the calculation to triaxial ellipsoids. We find that strongly deformed spheroids exhibit a non-monotonic dependence of polarization on viewing angle, a behavior overlooked in previous studies. Triaxial ellipsoids show more diverse polarization signatures, but their qualitative behavior can be understood from the area of surface elements viewed nearly edge-on, where the local polarization is strongest. Our results provide a simple physical understanding of the dependence of polarization on photospheric geometry and help constrain the geometry of astrophysical transients through polarimetric observations. The computational results of this study will be made publicly available for use in future research.

title: Dust at cosmic dawn: unveiling the onset of dust and obscured star formation at $z\gtrsim8$
background_knowledge: 宇宙尘埃是星系星际介质中的固态颗粒，虽然只占星系重子质量的不到 1%，却能高效吸收紫外和光学波段的星光，并在红外至（亚）毫米波段再辐射。因此，尘埃既是星系多波段外观的关键调节者，也是遮蔽恒星形成、使静止系紫外/光学巡天漏掉部分星系演化的主要因素。高红移星系研究通常结合 JWST 等红外望远镜的静止系紫外/光学观测与 ALMA 等（亚）毫米干涉仪的远红外热尘埃连续谱观测：前者追踪未被遮蔽的恒星形成，后者通过拟合尘埃发射的谱能量分布，测量尘埃质量、尘埃温度、红外光度以及被遮蔽的恒星形成率。在 $z > 8$ 的宇宙黎明，星系金属丰度低、尘埃库可能刚由超新星抛射物冷凝或星际介质中的尘埃增长建立，观测难度极大，当前 ALMA 灵敏度难以常规探测。该领域的核心问题包括：早期尘埃从何而来，超新星与尘埃增长各自贡献多少，以及尘埃在多大程度上遮蔽了宇宙黎明时期的星系形成。下一代（亚）毫米设施因此被视为连接 JWST 发现与尘埃遮蔽星系演化图景的关键。
contribution: 论文的核心工作是论证 ALMA2040——下一代（亚）毫米干涉仪——对研究 $z > 8$ 宇宙黎明尘埃与遮蔽恒星形成的变革性能力。相较 ALMA，ALMA2040 的灵敏度提升约一个数量级，**将能够常规探测 $z > 8$ 星系的尘埃辐射**，并通过同时多波段表征**准确测量其尘埃质量、尘埃温度和红外光度**。结合辅助金属丰度测量（包括 ALMA2040 自身探测到的远红外谱线），该设施**将厘清超新星与尘埃颗粒增长在最早星系尘埃积累中的相对作用**。同时，ALMA2040 **将测量宇宙黎明时期被尘埃遮蔽的恒星形成比例**，从而量化静止系紫外/光学巡天遗漏的早期星系形成部分。论文强调，若没有 ALMA 约 10 倍的升级（相当于从 VLT 到 ELT 的跨越），我们将无法充分利用 JWST 带来的重大进展，并将继续对 $z > 8$ 宇宙中冷而遮蔽的星系形成成分视而不见。
summary: Although less than 1 percent of the baryonic mass budget of a galaxy, cosmic dust profoundly alters the multi-wavelength appearance of galaxies across cosmic time. The (sub)millimeter wavelength regime is uniquely capable of weighing these dust reservoirs, and revealing the total extent of galaxy evolution that remains hidden behind them. With current facilities, however, doing so at $z > 8$ is largely out of reach. ALMA2040, a next-generation (sub)millimeter interferometer, is set to change this. Through an order-of-magnitude increase in sensitivity compared to ALMA, ALMA2040 is a transformational facility that will be able to routinely detect dust emission from galaxies at $z > 8$ and, through simultaneous multi-band characterization, accurately measure their dust masses, temperatures, and infrared luminosities. Combined with ancillary metallicity measurements -- including from the far-infrared lines detected by ALMA2040 itself -- this will establish the relative roles of supernovae and grain growth in building up dust in the earliest galaxies. Simultaneously, ALMA2040 will measure the fraction of star formation that is obscured by dust at cosmic dawn, and thereby the extent to which rest-UV and optical surveys miss early galaxy build-up. Without a 10$\times$ upgrade to ALMA -- comparable to the leap from the VLT to the ELT -- we will not be able to capitalize on the momentous advances enabled by JWST, and will remain blind to the cold and obscured component of galaxy formation in the $z > 8$ Universe.

title: From Non-Thermal to Thermal: Cosmological Imprints of Self-Interacting Secluded Dark Matter
background_knowledge: 在标准宇宙学中，暗物质约占宇宙能量密度的 27%，是宇宙大尺度结构形成的关键组分。尽管冷暗物质（CDM）模型在星系团及以上尺度非常成功，但暗物质的粒子身份、质量、产生机制，以及它是否与标准模型（SM）存在非引力耦合，仍是当代物理学的核心问题。早期宇宙中的暗物质可以通过 inflaton 衰变、冻结产生或非热产生等方式形成；其初始动量分布会决定自由流长度，并影响小尺度结构形成。若暗物质只通过引力与 SM 作用，而自身带有暗扇区自相互作用，则暗扇区内部可通过弹性散射达到动理学平衡，形成暗温度 $T_{\rm DM}$ 与化学势 $\mu$。由于弹性 $2 \rightarrow 2$ 散射保持粒子数，若没有改变粒子数的过程，热化后通常不能把化学势降为零，因此暗扇区热分布会带有非零 $\mu$。此外，大爆炸核合成（BBN）对辐射能量密度非常敏感，暗扇区温度与 SM 温度之比会受到宇宙学约束。Warm DM 情形下，自由流会抹平小尺度功率，从而给出暗物质质量下限；自相互作用与内部热化则可改变这一自由流历史，进而改变质量限制。reheating 阶段中，inflaton 场相干振荡并微扰衰变产生粒子，定义了 reheating 温度 $T_{\rm RH}$，这也为暗物质产生提供了非热初始条件。
contribution: 论文研究一个与标准模型分离的实标量暗物质场，其具有四次自耦合，并在 reheating 阶段由相干振荡的 inflaton 场微扰衰变产生。作者通过求解暗物质动量分布函数的 Boltzmann 方程，并计入 $2 \rightarrow 2$ 暗物质弹性自散射，数值研究了暗扇区从非热到内部热化的演化。由于没有改变粒子数的过程，热化后的暗扇区由暗温度 $T_{\rm DM}$ 和非零化学势 $\mu$ 描述，二者由 inflaton 质量 $m_{\rm inflaton}$ 与 reheating 温度 $T_{\rm RH}$ 决定。**若 $m_{\rm inflaton} > T_{\rm RH}$，则在 BBN 时期暗物质温度可高于 SM 温度，同时对应 $\mu < 0$；若 $m_{\rm inflaton} < T_{\rm RH}$，则暗物质温度可低于 SM 温度，同时对应 $\mu > 0$，且不违反宇宙学约束。** 根据暗物质产生历史，暗物质质量下限可远低于 warm DM 情形。自散射导致的热化会压低暗物质的共动自由流长度，相比无碰撞的非热情形，**对于合适的四次自耦合，暗物质质量下限约减弱 $40\%$**。取 $m_{\rm inflaton} = 10^3$ GeV 时，得到热化暗物质质量下限：当 $T_{\rm RH} = 5 \times 10^6$ GeV 时，$m_{\rm DM} \gtrsim 2.2 \times 10^{-10}$ GeV；当 $T_{\rm RH} = 5$ MeV 时，$m_{\rm DM} \gtrsim 0.47$ GeV。
summary: Dark matter (DM), secluded from the Standard Model (SM), can attain internal thermalization through self-interactions. We investigate the thermalization of a real scalar DM field with a quartic self-coupling, initially produced from the perturbative decay of the coherently oscillating inflaton field during reheating. The thermalization process has been studied numerically by solving Boltzmann equation of the DM momentum distribution function in presence of $2\rightarrow2$ DM elastic self-scatterings. In the absence of number-changing processes, the thermalized dark sector is characterized by a temperature and a nonzero chemical potential, determined by the inflaton mass and the reheat temperature. We find that if the inflaton mass is greater (smaller) than the reheat temperature, the DM temperature can be greater (smaller) than the SM temperature during Big Bang Nucleosynthesis, without violating any cosmological constraints. This is realized with a negative (positive) chemical potential for the DM temperature greater (smaller) than the SM one. Depending on DM production history, we can achieve the lower limit on the DM mass much below than in warm DM scenarios. The thermalization via self-scatterings tends to suppress the DM co-moving free-streaming length, compared to the non-thermal scenario without any collisions. Consequently, the lower limit on the DM mass weakens approximately by $40\%$ for a suitable choice of quartic self-coupling than in the non-thermal scenario. We obtain the lower limits on the thermal DM mass to be $2.2\times10^{-10}$ GeV and $0.47$ GeV for reheat temperatures, $5\times 10^6$ GeV and $5$ MeV respectively, while the inflaton mass is set at $10^3$ GeV.

title: AGN Feeding and Feedback: Resolving the Torus
background_knowledge: 活动星系核（Active Galactic Nuclei，AGN）由星系中心超大质量黑洞（Supermassive Black Hole，SMBH）吸积物质驱动，是宇宙中最高效的能量释放源之一。围绕 SMBH 的尘埃分子环面（torus）和核周区域连接了星系尺度气体库与黑洞吸积盘，承担着“供给”（feeding）物质和“反馈”（feedback）能量的双重角色。AGN 反馈可通过辐射、风、喷流等机制加热或驱散宿主星系中的冷气体，从而抑制或触发恒星形成，并与星系的共同演化密切相关。在观测上，尘埃环面的尺度极小，且常被遮蔽；不同视线方向会造成吸收与再辐射差异，这也是 AGN 统一模型的重要基础。要理解物质如何从星系盘输运到吸积盘、以及反馈如何影响周围气体，需要在红外至毫米/亚毫米波段获得高灵敏度、高角分辨率的观测，尤其是分辨近邻活动星系核的核周动力学，并解析更高红移、更高光度 AGN 的环面结构。
contribution: 该工作聚焦 AGN 供给与反馈中的关键瓶颈：尘埃分子环面的解析。目前多数信息来自极近邻活动星系（$z < 0.008$；$D < 35$ Mpc），这些观测提供了最佳空间分辨率，并揭示了随机取向的尘埃分子环面为 SMBH 供给物质。摘要指出，现有以及计划中的观测设施仍难以回答两个基本问题，而 ALMA2040 这类具备显著更高灵敏度和更好角分辨率的设施将推动进展：（i）**探测近邻星系中一直延伸到吸积盘的物质供给动力学**；（ii）**空间分辨更高能量、更具宇宙学意义的活动星系核的环面与核周区域，例如红移 $z \sim 0.1$、$L_{\mathrm{bol}} > 10^{45}$ erg s$^{-1}$ 的本地类星体**。核心结论是，下一代毫米/亚毫米干涉观测有望把 AGN 供给与反馈研究从近邻个案推进到更具代表性的活跃星系样本。
summary: Active Galactic Nuclei (AGN) play a key role in galaxy evolution by regulating star formation within their host galaxies. It is therefore crucial to understand how the central supermassive black holes (SMBH) are fueled by material from the galactic disk, and how AGN feedback impacts the surrounding gas. Most information so far comes from very nearby active galaxies (z < 0.008; D < 35 Mpc), providing the best spatial resolution and revealing randomly oriented dusty molecular tori that fuel SMBHs. A facility such as ALMA2040, offering significantly higher sensitivity and better angular resolution than current ALMA, would enable progress in two fundamental areas that remain beyond the capabilities of all existing and planned observatories: (i) probing the dynamics of the material feeding the AGN down to the accretion disk in nearby galaxies; and (ii) spatially resolving the tori and circum-nuclear regions of more energetic and cosmologically significant AGN, such as local quasars (z ~ 0.1 and Lbol > 10^45 erg/s).

title: From Cosmic Bounces to Primordial Black Holes: The Role of Primordial Magnetic Fields
background_knowledge: 宇宙极早期物理关注暴胀、反弹与循环模型等范式如何产生原初扰动和可观测遗迹。标准暴胀通过标量场慢滚放大量子涨落；ekpyrotic 反弹模型则让宇宙经历收缩、非奇异反弹再进入膨胀，收缩阶段可放大特定场的涨落。若电磁场与标量背景存在时间依赖耦合，共形不变性被破坏，真空涨落可被拉伸并放大成原初磁场。磁场形成后可通过各向异性应力（anisotropic stress）反馈到度规与曲率扰动，并在辐射主导时期贡献或主导密度扰动。密度扰动超过阈值时，视界尺度内的过密区可坍缩成原初黑洞（PBH）；其质量由坍缩时的视界质量及坍缩判据决定，丰度常以 PBH 占暗物质比例 $f_{\mathrm{PBH}}$ 表示。PBH 丰度计算敏感于曲率谱的紫外行为、截断波数、阈值与坍缩模型（单色坍缩或临界坍缩），并与原初磁场反作用、过闭合等宇宙学约束相互联系。
contribution: 论文研究非奇异 ekpyrotic 反弹过程中产生的原初磁场如何导致原初黑洞（PBH）形成。电磁场与标量背景的时间依赖耦合破坏共形不变性，在收缩阶段放大概率场涨落，产生在辐射主导时期各向异性应力占主导的磁场。通过保留有限波数截断，作者计算紫外主导的曲率谱、密度扰动方差，并用单色坍缩与临界坍缩两种方案确定 PBH 丰度。对基准参数，临界坍缩质量谱峰值位于 $M \simeq 2.0 \times 10^{-3} M_\odot$，总 PBH 暗物质比例为 $f_{\mathrm{PBH}} \approx 10^{-5}$，形成**次主导的亚太阳质量 PBH 群体**。施加宇宙学过闭合限制 $f_{\mathrm{PBH}} \le 1$ 后，可约束主要背景参数：收缩结束时的 Hubble 尺度 $H_{\mathrm{end}} \le 1.6 \times 10^3~\mathrm{GeV}$，以及收缩指数 $q \le 0.247$，从而给出与电磁反作用极限一致物理边界。若要转向小行星质量 PBH 或更大的暗物质比例，则需修改紫外截断和收缩持续时间。该分析强调了有限波数截断与假定坍缩方案在联系反弹磁成因与预测 PBH 丰度中的关键作用。
summary: We investigate primordial black hole (PBH) formation from primordial magnetic fields generated during a non-singular ekpyrotic bounce. A time-dependent coupling between the electromagnetic field and a scalar background breaks conformal invariance and amplifies gauge field fluctuations during contraction, generating magnetic fields whose anisotropic stress dominates during radiation domination. By retaining finite-wavenumber cutoffs, we compute the ultraviolet-dominated curvature spectrum, evaluate density-perturbation variance, and determine PBH abundances using both monochromatic and critical-collapse prescriptions. For benchmark parameters, the critical collapse mass spectrum peaks at $M\simeq 2.0\times10^{-3}M_\odot$ , with a total PBH dark matter fraction of $f_{PBH}\approx 10^{-5}$, forming a subdominant subsolar PBH population. Enforcing the cosmological overclosure bound ($f_{\mathrm{PBH}} \le 1$) constrains the primary background parameters, namely the end-of-contraction Hubble scale ($H_{\mathrm{end}} \le 1.6 \times 10^3~\mathrm{GeV}$) and the contraction exponent ($q \le 0.247$), establishing a physical boundary consistent with the electromagnetic backreaction limit. Shifting to asteroid-mass PBHs or a larger dark matter fraction requires modifying the ultraviolet cutoff and contraction duration. This analysis highlights the essential role of finite-wavenumber cutoffs and assumed-collapse prescriptions in linking bounce magnetogenesis to the predicted PBH abundance.

title: Beyond the Beacon: State and Corporate Competition after an Information-Rich Technosignature Detection
background_knowledge:
本论文属于 SETI（搜寻地外智慧生命）领域的"探测后治理"研究，其背景横跨射电天文学、科学社会学与国际科技政策，而非传统天体物理观测本身。
\n自 20 世纪 80 年代末以来，国际宇航科学院（International Academy of Astronautics, IAA）SETI 常设委员会逐步制定并多次更新《关于搜寻地外智慧生命行为原则的宣言》（Declaration of Principles Concerning the Conduct of the Search for Extraterrestrial Intelligence），为"一旦探测到疑似信号应当怎么做"提供非强制的行为框架：发现方需与独立观测者交叉验证，排除射电频率干扰（RFI）、卫星下行链路、行星雷达泄漏等人工来源，以及脉冲星、快速射电暴（FRB）、微波激射、等离子体透镜等自然天体物理源；确认后应经由国际天文学联合会（IAU）等渠道向全球通报，并公开保存数据、方法与代码。
\n这一框架背后隐含着一个长期主导的物理图像：探测对象是"信标"（beacon）——一种以"被识别"为主要目的、信息内容相对贫乏的信号。在这一范式下，后探测阶段的核心难题是"确认"：证明信号的非自然起源、排除各种干扰。相应地，治理议题集中于验证标准、通报流程与数据公开，而非信号内容的归属与解读。
\n随着"技术标志"（technosignature）概念不断拓宽（涵盖光学闪变、工业污染光谱、人工天体结构等），学界也开始设想一种更强的场景：信号本身携带可恢复、可解读的数据、图像或机器可读内容，即"信息丰富"的技术标志。这类信号把后探测的挑战重心从"是否存在他者"推向"如何处理他者留下的信息"。
\n与此同时，后探测的地缘政治维度近年受到关注：谁先接收、谁掌握原始数据、谁有权解码与发布，都牵涉国家声望、安全与科技竞争优势。既有文献多以国家行为体为分析单位，却较少讨论拥有大规模算力、人工智能能力乃至接收基础设施的私营企业——它们不受 SETI 社区规范约束，也无强制披露义务。此外，宣言本身是高度凝练的原则性文件，其可操作性依赖后续补充材料对具体议题的深入讨论。
contribution:
论文针对 2026 年更新的《关于搜寻地外智慧生命行为原则的宣言》，聚焦一个此前鲜被直接研究的场景：探测到"信息丰富的技术标志"，即信号携带数据、图像或机器可读内容。
\n作者指出，主流探测概念仍停留在"信标"层面，而一旦信号内容可被恢复并可能被加以利用，**后探测挑战的重心将从"验证"整体转向"信息托管"（information stewardship）**，并会催生各方竞相解码、抢先使用信号的竞争性努力。
\n论文进一步批评既有地缘政治研究主要从国家行为体角度理解后探测竞争，并提出一个未被充分考察的关键维度：**大型企业如今已具备独立追踪地外信号所需的算力、人工智能能力，部分甚至拥有接收基础设施，却不承担任何披露发现的义务**，这**实质性地改变了后探测的整体格局**。
\n这些考量直接关系到宣言对开放与透明的承诺，以及在 SETI 社区之外、可能并不认同该承诺的强大行为体存在时，这一承诺如何得以维系。据此，作者**将"信息丰富的技术标志"正式确立为需要制定补充指南（supplementary guidance）的议题，并提出一组供 SETI 社区初步思考与讨论的问题清单**。
summary: The 2026 update to the Declaration of Principles Concerning the Conduct of the Search for Extraterrestrial Intelligence provides a framework for post-detection practice. Like earlier versions, it addresses information content directly: a confirmation report should record any detected content, and the underlying data, methods, and code should be openly preserved and disseminated. The declaration is necessarily concise and is intended to be supported by supplementary material that examines specific issues in greater depth. This paper contributes to that process by considering the possible detection of an information-rich technosignature: a signal carrying data, imagery, or machine-readable content. Whereas the prevailing concept of a detection remains that of a beacon, a signal with recoverable and potentially exploitable content would shift much of the post-detection challenge from verification to information stewardship, while encouraging competitive efforts to decode and use the signal. Few studies have addressed this scenario directly, and the geopolitical literature has so far framed post-detection competition mainly in terms of state actors. Large corporations now possess the computing power, AI capabilities, and, in some cases, receiving infrastructure needed to independently pursue an extraterrestrial signal without any obligation to disclose their findings. This largely unexamined dimension materially changes the post-detection landscape. These considerations bear directly on the declaration's commitment to openness and transparency, and on how that commitment can be upheld when powerful actors outside the SETI community may not share it. I identify information-rich technosignatures as a topic for supplementary guidance and offer a preliminary set of questions for the community to consider.

title: A Search for Dust in the Outflow of the HH212 Class 0 Protostellar System
